definition_zh: 保险；保险费；保险业；保障
definition_en: an arrangement in which a company pays for loss or damage in return for regular payments, or the money paid for it
core_image: 一张纸写着「出事由我赔」，旁边是一摞按月交钱的小票
scene: 柜台上放着一份厚厚的保单，客户在末尾签下了名字。She pays a small sum each month for travel insurance.
sceneCN: 这里 insurance 是「保险」（第 1 个义项：花钱买一份出事后可索赔的保障），句意为她每月交一笔小钱买旅行保险。画面里的物件：保单、签名笔、缴费小票。

pos.zh: 名词：保险；保险费；保险业；保障

derivatives.zh: 由本词去尾构成，义为「给……保险；确保」
由 insure 加 -er 构成，义为「保险公司；承保人」
由 insure 加 -ed 构成，义为「已投保的」
由 insure 加 -able 构成，义为「可保险的」

senses.title: Cover against loss
senses.definition: an agreement in which a company promises to pay you if you suffer loss, damage, or injury
senses.definitionCN: 一种约定：一旦你遭受损失、损坏或伤害，公司承诺向你赔付
senses.example: My grandfather has kept the same insurance on his house for thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 我祖父那栋房子的保险三十年没换过。
senses.why: Latin securus means "free from care"; insurance is the promise that someone will take care of the loss.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 securus 意为「无忧」，insurance 就是有人会替你承担损失的那句承诺。

senses.title: The money you pay
senses.definition: the regular sum of money paid to a company so that the agreement stays in force
senses.definitionCN: 为使约定持续有效而定期交给公司的一笔钱
senses.example: The insurance on the old van costs more than the van is worth.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆旧货车的保险费比车本身还值钱。
senses.why: In everyday speech the abstract promise and the money paid for it share one word.
senses.whyCN: 在日常口语里，抽象的那份承诺和为它付的钱共用同一个词。

senses.title: The business itself
senses.definition: the industry or practice of selling this kind of protection
senses.definitionCN: 出售这类保障的行业或做法
senses.example: Insurance is one of the biggest employers in that city.
senses.exampleCN: 保险业是那座城市最大的雇主之一。
senses.why: From a single policy the word widened to name the whole trade built on policies.
senses.whyCN: 从一张保单出发，这个词扩展成了建立在保单之上的整个行业。

senses.title: A safeguard in general
senses.definition: anything that protects you or makes a bad outcome less likely
senses.definitionCN: 任何能保护你、或使坏结果不易发生的事物
senses.example: Saving money is the best insurance against a sudden job loss.
senses.exampleCN: 存钱是应对突然失业的最好保障。
senses.why: The figurative use moves from paperwork to life: whatever cushions a shock works like insurance.
senses.whyCN: 比喻用法从纸面文件转到生活中：任何能缓冲冲击的东西都像保险一样起作用。

intro.en: Insurance grew out of the Latin adjective securus through French; the ending shifted in English to suit the trade.
intro.cn: insurance 源自拉丁语形容词 securus，经法语进入英语，词尾在英语里为适应这个行业而发生了变化。

items.en: The adjective securus, from se- "without" and cura "care", meant "free from care".
items.cn: 形容词 securus 由 se-「无」与 cura「忧虑」合成，义为「无忧的」。

items.en: Medieval merchants used securitas for the merchant guarantee behind a sea loan.
items.cn: 中世纪商人用 securitas 指海上借贷背后的商业担保。

items.en: Old French ensured the word as enseurance, meaning a promise to make someone safe.
items.cn: 古法语把它定型为 enseurance，意为「使人安全的承诺」。

items.en: English merchants of the sixteenth century used assurance for sea trade; insurance replaced it for the business of paying against risk.
items.cn: 十六世纪的英国商人用 assurance 指海上贸易；insurance 后来接替它表示对风险赔付的行业。

items.en: In the nineteenth century insurance broadened from ships to houses, health, and finally to any safeguard in speech.
items.cn: 十九世纪 insurance 从船舶扩展到房屋、健康，最后在日常言语中泛指任何保障。

note.en: The look-alike group hangs on the same Latin root of care and safety; the near-meaning group holds other words for protection.
note.cn: 形近组都挂在「忧虑、安全」这个拉丁词根上；近义组收其他表示保护的词。

entries.definition: A firm promise; in British English also a kind of life cover.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「保证」，英式英语中也指某类人寿保险。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to arrange cover or to make certain.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「投保；确保」。

entries.definition: Safe, or to fasten and make safe.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「安全的」，动词义为「使牢固、弄稳」。

entries.definition: The written contract of an insurance arrangement.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「保单」，即保险的书面合同。

entries.definition: The fixed amount paid regularly for cover.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「保险费」，即定期缴纳的固定金额。

entries.definition: The general state of being kept safe, wider than any contract.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「保护」，比合同意义上的保险更宽泛。

normalIntro.en: These hooks attach to the idea of care and the phrases insurance really appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子围绕「忧虑、照看」这个念头，并挂上 insurance 的真实搭配。

normal.en: in- plus sur- means "into the sure": you buy your way into safety.
normal.cn: in- 加 sur- 是「进入保险状态」：花钱买进安全里。

normal.en: The same family gives insure, assured and secure.
normal.cn: 同一词族给出 insure、assured、secure。

normal.en: An insurance company sells promises, not goods.
normal.cn: 保险公司卖的是承诺，而不是货物。

normal.en: Health insurance is the first thing a family budgets for.
normal.cn: 健康保险是一个家庭预算里最先安排的一项。

normal.en: Saving is insurance against the unexpected.
normal.cn: 储蓄是对意外的一种保险。

abstract.en: Insurance is a crowd sharing one person's bad day.
abstract.cn: 保险是一群人共同分担一个人的倒霉日子。

abstract.en: A policy is paper that turns into money only when things go wrong.
abstract.cn: 保单是一张只在出事时才变成钱的纸。

abstract.en: The word means care removed: someone else now carries the worry.
abstract.cn: 这个词的意思是「忧虑被移走」：如今别人替你担着那份心。

examples.en: The repair bill was far less painful because of his insurance.
examples.cn: 因为有保险，那笔修理费让人轻松多了。

examples.en: Insurance for the whole family rose again this year.
examples.cn: 全家的保险费今年又涨了。

examples.en: She treats a full pantry as insurance against hard times.
examples.cn: 她把塞满的储物柜当作应对艰难时日的保障。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阴输瑞思」——阴天输了也不慌，因为有保险

root: 拉丁语 cura「忧虑」→ securus「无忧的」→ 中世纪拉丁语 securitas「担保」→ 古法语 enseurance → 英语 insurance。同族词还有 insure、assurance、secure。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: the promise of cover, the money paid for it, the trade that sells it, and any safeguard in ordinary life.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：赔付的承诺、为此付的钱、出售它的行业，以及生活中任何形式的保障。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a signed promise that a loss will be paid for.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张签好的承诺，保证损失会有人赔付。

branches.en: THE CONTRACT: the company promises to pay when loss happens.
branches.cn: 合同这条线：公司承诺出事就赔。

branches.en: THE PREMIUM: the money handed over keeps the promise alive.
branches.cn: 保费这条线：交出去的钱让承诺继续有效。

branches.en: THE TRADE: a whole industry lives on selling such promises.
branches.cn: 行业这条线：整个产业靠出售这类承诺生存。

branches.en: THE SAVINGS JAR: anything that softens a shock acts as insurance.
branches.cn: 存钱罐这条线：任何能缓冲冲击的东西都起到保险作用。

branches.en: THE LINK: promise and payment are two sides of the same policy.
branches.cn: 连接线：承诺与付款是同一张保单的两面。

intro.en: Insurance splits into the negative prefix in-, the root secur- "care-free", and the noun ending -ance.
intro.cn: insurance 可拆为否定前缀 in-、词根 secur-「无忧」与名词词尾 -ance。

latinIntro.en: Latin cura and securus are well attested; only the deepest Indo-European layer is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura 与 securus 均有记载，只有最深层的印欧语形式属于重构。

items.example: It marks entry into a safe state.
items.exampleCN: 它标出进入安全状态的动作。

items.example: The root also lives in secure and security.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 secure 与 security。

items.example: The noun is the oldest member of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是这一词族最古老的成员。

items.example: The adjective joins se- with cura.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词由 se- 与 cura 合成。

items.example: Medieval use shifted it towards a guarantee.
items.exampleCN: 中世纪用法使它转向「担保」。

items.example: It turns the stem into an abstract noun.
items.exampleCN: 它把词干变成抽象名词。

items.example: The verb was borrowed from Old French.
The suffix names the one who acts.
items.exampleCN: 后缀标出动作的施行者。

definition_zh: 给……保险；确保；保证
definition_en: to arrange for a company to pay for loss or damage, or to make something certain
core_image: 把一件贵重东西交到窗口，换回一张写着「我替你担着」的凭证
scene: 柜员把贵重的相机仔细包好，又在单据上盖章。Please insure the parcel before you send it abroad.
sceneCN: 这里 insure 是「给……投保」（第 1 个义项：为物品买保险），句意为寄往国外前请先给包裹投保。画面里的物件：相机、单据、印章。

pos.zh: 动词：投保；确保；保证

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ance 构成，义为「保险」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「保险公司」
由过去分词转作名词，义为「被保险人」
由本词加 -able 构成，义为「可承保的」

senses.title: Buy cover for something
senses.definition: to pay a company regularly so that it will pay you if the thing named is lost or damaged
senses.definitionCN: 定期付钱给公司，以便所指定的东西丢失或损坏时由它赔付
senses.example: They insured the piano before the movers arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 搬迁工来之前他们给钢琴投了保。
senses.why: Old French enseurer meant to make sure; the commercial sense grew from protecting goods at sea.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 enseurer 意为「使确定」，商业义从保护海上货物发展而来。

senses.title: Make certain
senses.definition: to make something certain to happen, especially by taking action in advance
senses.definitionCN: 尤指通过事先行动使某事必定发生
senses.example: Book early to insure yourself a seat by the window.
senses.exampleCN: 早点预订，确保给自己留一个靠窗的座位。
senses.why: This sense is close to ensure and dominates in American writing.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项与 ensure 相近，在美式写作中占主导。

senses.title: Promise firmly
senses.definition: to state firmly that something is true or will be done
senses.definitionCN: 坚定地声明某事为真或将被做到
senses.example: He insured me that the parts would arrive on Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 他向我保证零件周一会到。
senses.why: The old promise sense survives in legal and formal speech.
senses.whyCN: 古老的「承诺」义仍存在于法律与正式语体中。

intro.en: Insure descends from Latin securus through Old French enseurer, and entered English with the sea trade.
intro.cn: insure 由拉丁语 securus 经古法语 enseurer 传来，随海上贸易进入英语。

items.en: Securus, "free from care", was built from se- "without" and cura "care".
items.cn: securus「无忧的」由 se-「无」与 cura「忧虑」构成。

items.en: Securare meant to set free from worry or to give a pledge.
items.cn: securare 意为「使无忧」，也指给出担保。

items.en: Enseurer "to make sure" carried the pledge sense into French commerce.
items.cn: enseurer「使确定」把担保义带入法语商业用语。

items.en: Sixteenth-century English merchants wrote ensuren for goods shipped overseas.
items.cn: 十六世纪的英国商人用 ensuren 指海外运输的货物。

items.en: Spelling settled as insure, and American usage kept it also in the sense of ensure.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 insure，美式英语还用它表示 ensure 的意思。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the pledge root; the near-meaning group holds words about making things certain.
note.cn: 形近组共享「担保」这一词根；近义组收表示「使确定」的词。

entries.definition: To make certain that something happens.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「确保」，强调使某事发生。

entries.definition: To tell someone confidently so as to remove doubt.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使某人确信」，强调打消对方疑虑。

entries.definition: The contract or money behind such protection.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「保险」，指其背后的合同或费用。

entries.definition: To promise formally to answer for a result.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「担保」，正式承诺为结果负责。

entries.definition: To obtain something after effort, or to fasten it.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「弄到；固定住」。

entries.definition: To keep someone or something from harm.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「保护」，侧重免受伤害。

normalIntro.en: The hooks work from the sure inside insure and from the phrases it keeps company with.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从 insure 中间那个 sure「确定」出发，并借助它的常见搭配。

normal.en: in plus sure: put your goods in a sure place.
normal.cn: in 加 sure：把东西放进稳妥之处。

normal.en: Insure the parcel against damage, insure that the door is locked.
normal.cn: 给包裹投保防损，也确保门已锁好。

normal.en: American writers often use insure where British writers use ensure.
normal.cn: 美式作者常用 insure，而英式作者用 ensure。

normal.en: Only the insured can claim from the insurer.
normal.cn: 只有被保险人才能向保险公司索赔。

normal.en: Insure what you cannot afford to lose.
normal.cn: 给那些丢了赔不起的东西投保。

abstract.en: To insure is to buy a calm night from a company.
abstract.cn: 投保就是向公司买一个安稳的夜晚。

abstract.en: The word carries two jobs: cover the risk, and remove the doubt.
abstract.cn: 这个词承担两份工作：兜住风险，也消除疑虑。

abstract.en: A careful traveller insures the trip before feeling excited about it.
abstract.cn: 细心的旅客先给旅程投保，再为它兴奋。

examples.en: Make sure you insure the laptop before the trip.
examples.cn: 出发前一定要给笔记本电脑投保。

examples.en: The club insured its players against injury.
examples.cn: 俱乐部为球员投保了伤病险。

examples.en: Hard practice will insure a better result next term.
examples.cn: 刻苦练习能确保下学期有更好的成绩。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因输尔」——怕因为输了而受损，先去投保

root: 拉丁语 cura「忧虑」→ securus「无忧的」→ securare「使无忧、担保」→ 古法语 enseurer「使确定」→ 英语 insure。与 insurance、ensure、assure 同源。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: buying cover, making something certain, and giving a firm promise.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：买东西的保障、使某事确定，以及郑重承诺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hand something valuable over and get back a written pledge.
core.cn: 核心意象：把贵重东西交出去，换回一纸担保。

branches.en: THE PARCEL: goods are covered against loss before shipping.
branches.cn: 包裹这条线：货物在发运前被投保防损。

branches.en: THE EARLY BOOKING: acting ahead makes the seat certain.
branches.cn: 早订这条线：提前行动让座位变得确定。

branches.en: THE FORMAL WORD: a spoken pledge in legal or polite speech.
branches.cn: 正式承诺这条线：法律或客套话里的郑重保证。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses remove worry about what might happen.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都在消除对可能发生之事的担忧。

branches.en: THE LINK: cover and promise both rest on someone else's word.
branches.cn: 连接线：保险与承诺都建立在别人的一句话上。

intro.en: Insure lines up in-, the root sur- from securus, and the verb ending -e.
intro.cn: insure 可拆为 in-、来自 securus 的词根 sur- 与动词词尾 -e。

latinIntro.en: Latin securus and securare are recorded; the reconstructed layer lies further back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 securus 与 securare 均有记录，重构层在更早的阶段。

items.example: It marks entry into a safe state.
The root shows clearly in assure and secure.
items.exampleCN: 这一词根在 assure 与 secure 中很明显。

items.example: It is the verb behind the French form.
items.exampleCN: 它是法语形式背后的拉丁动词。

items.example: The French form gave English the spelling.
items.exampleCN: 法语形式给出了英语的拼写。
另一个单独借入的近亲。

definition_zh: 使合并；使成为一体；融入
definition_en: to combine two or more things so that they work together as one whole
core_image: 几块零散的零件被装进同一台机器，接线合成一个回路
scene: 车间里摆着几个各自能转的旧装置，工程师把它们接到同一个控制盘上。The new software lets us integrate billing and delivery into one screen.
sceneCN: 这里 integrate 是「使合并为一体」（第 1 个义项：把几部分结合成整体），句意为新软件让我们把账单和配送合到同一屏幕。画面里的物件：旧装置、控制盘、接线。

pos.zh: 动词：使合并；使一体化；融入

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「整合；一体化」
由过去分词转作形容词，义为「综合的；一体化的」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「有整合作用的」
由否定前缀 dis- 加本词构成，义为「瓦解；分解」

senses.title: Join parts into a whole
senses.definition: to combine separate parts or systems so that they form one working whole
senses.definitionCN: 把彼此分开的部分或系统组合成一个能运转的整体
senses.example: The team spent a year integrating the two computer systems.
senses.exampleCN: 团队花了一年时间把两套电脑系统整合起来。
senses.why: Latin integer means untouched and whole; integrare is to make whole again.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 integer 意为「完整无损」，integrare 即「使之重新完整」。

senses.title: Fit into a new group
senses.definition: to become an accepted part of a group, school, or society
senses.definitionCN: 成为某个群体、学校或社会中被接受的一员
senses.example: New students need time to integrate into the class.
senses.exampleCN: 新生需要时间融入班级。
senses.why: The social sense grew in the twentieth century, when schools and workplaces stopped separating groups.
senses.whyCN: 社会义在二十世纪成长起来，那时学校与工作场所不再分隔不同群体。

senses.title: Do the combining
senses.definition: to arrange for two activities or services to be handled together
senses.definitionCN: 安排两项活动或服务一并处理
senses.example: The hotel integrated its booking system with the airline's.
senses.exampleCN: 这家酒店把预订系统与航空公司的连在一起。
senses.why: Businesses picked up the word because customers want one bill, not three.
senses.whyCN: 商业界采纳这个词，因为顾客想要一张账单而不是三张。

intro.en: Integrate rests on the Latin adjective integer "whole", a favourite word of Roman writers on number and health.
intro.cn: integrate 基于拉丁语形容词 integer「完整的」，这是罗马作家谈数目与健康时爱用的词。

items.en: Integer means whole, untouched, in good condition, from in- "not" and a root for touching.
items.cn: integer 意为「完整的、未被触动的、状况良好的」，由 in-「不」与表示「触碰」的词根构成。

items.en: Integrare "to make whole, to renew" appears in classical prose.
items.cn: integrare「使完整、更新」见于古典散文。

items.en: Integratio "a renewing" was used for restoring a whole state, including health.
items.cn: integratio「更新」用于恢复完整状态，也包括健康。

items.en: English took the verb in the seventeenth century for rebuilding a whole from parts.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入这个动词，指用部分重建整体。

items.en: The twentieth century added the social sense of groups learning to live together.
items.cn: 二十世纪又添上了群体学会共处的社会义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin root for wholeness; the near-meaning group holds other words for joining.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「完整」词根；近义组收其他表示「结合」的词。

entries.definition: A whole number, one undivided unit.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「整数」，即不可分割的整单位。

entries.definition: Wholeness of character; an unbroken state.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「正直；完整」，指品行或状态的完整无损。

entries.definition: Necessary to the whole, not optional.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「构成整体所必需的」。

entries.definition: To put things together, often while keeping them distinct.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「结合」，各成分往往仍可分辨。

entries.definition: To join so that the parts lose their separate lines.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「合并」，各部分界线消失。

entries.definition: To bring people or groups together for one aim.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「联合」，多用于人与团体为一目标而合。

normalIntro.en: The hooks build on integer, the whole number at the heart of the word.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子建立在词中间的 integer「整数」之上，那正是「完整」的意思。

normal.en: integer is a whole number: integrate is to make a whole.
normal.cn: integer 是完整的数：integrate 就是把东西做成完整。

normal.en: Integrate the two systems with one cable, and the bill appears once.
normal.cn: 用一根线把两套系统整合，账单就只出现一次。

normal.en: Immigrants integrate into a town by working, voting, and making friends.
normal.cn: 移民靠工作、投票和交朋友融入一座城镇。

normal.en: Dis- plus integrate gives the very opposite: to fall apart.
normal.cn: dis- 加 integrate 恰好是其反面：瓦解。

normal.en: A good designer integrates form and purpose.
normal.cn: 好的设计师把形式与用途合成一体。

abstract.en: To integrate is to let many voices become one choir.
abstract.cn: 整合就是让许多声音变成一个合唱。

abstract.en: A whole is not the pile of parts but the fit between them.
abstract.cn: 整体不是零件的堆叠，而是它们之间的契合。

abstract.en: Integration happens when a newcomer stops being a guest.
abstract.cn: 当新人不再是客人，融合就发生了。

examples.en: We must integrate the new staff into the team quickly.
examples.cn: 我们必须让新员工迅速融入团队。

examples.en: The app integrates maps with live train times.
examples.cn: 这款应用把地图与实时列车时刻结合起来。

examples.en: It takes years to integrate these small farms into one market.
examples.cn: 要把这些小农场并入同一个市场需要多年时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因太鬼特的」——零件太奇特，也得整合成一台机器

root: 拉丁语 tangere「触碰」→ in-「不」+ tangere → integer「未被触动的、完整的」→ integrare「使完整」→ 英语 integrate。同族词：integrity、integral、disintegrate。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: combining systems, fitting into a group, and linking services for convenience.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：整合系统、融入群体，以及为便利把服务连在一起。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: loose parts wired into one working machine.
core.cn: 核心意象：零散零件被接线成一台能运转的机器。

branches.en: THE CONTROL PANEL: separate devices answer to one board.
branches.cn: 控制盘这条线：分开的装置听命于同一块面板。

branches.en: THE CLASSROOM: a newcomer becomes part of the group.
branches.cn: 教室这条线：新来的人成为群体的一部分。

branches.en: THE SINGLE BILL: two services are handled as one.
branches.cn: 一张账单这条线：两项服务被并作一件处理。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses remove the seams between things.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都在消除事物之间的接缝。

branches.en: THE LINK: parts and people both become whole by fitting in.
branches.cn: 连接线：零件与人都是靠嵌合才变得完整。

intro.en: Integrate splits into in- "not", the root teg- "touch", and the verb ending -ate.
intro.cn: integrate 可拆为 in-「不」、词根 teg-「触碰」与动词词尾 -ate。

latinIntro.en: Latin integer, integrare and integratio are all recorded forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 integer、integrare、integratio 都是有记载的形式。

items.example: It gives the sense of untouched.
items.exampleCN: 它给出「未被触动」的意思。

items.example: The root also appears in contact and intact.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 contact 与 intact。

items.example: The adjective also gives English integer.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词也给出英语的 integer。

items.example: It is the direct source of the verb.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个动词的直接来源。

items.example: It marks a verb of action.
items.exampleCN: 它标出表示动作的动词。

items.example: The noun keeps the whole idea.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词保留了「完整」的意念。

items.example: The prefix turns wholeness into collapse.
items.exampleCN: 前缀把完整变成了崩解。

definition_zh: 整合；一体化；融合
definition_en: the act or process of combining parts so that they form one whole
core_image: 几条小溪汇进同一条河道，原来的沙洲被水连成一片
scene: 小镇上原本分开的两条公交线合并成一条线路，站牌也换了。The integration of the two schools took three careful years.
sceneCN: 这里 integration 是「整合、一体化」（第 1 个义项：把各部分合成整体的过程），句意为两所学校合并花了谨慎的三年。画面里的物件：合并站牌、新线路图、车票。

pos.zh: 名词：整合；一体化；融合

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉 -ion 构成，义为「整合；使一体」
由 integrate 加 -ed 构成，义为「一体化的」
由否定前缀 dis- 加本词构成，义为「瓦解」
由本词加 -ist 构成，义为「主张融合的」

senses.title: Putting parts into one system
senses.definition: the process of joining separate systems or parts so that they work as one
senses.definitionCN: 把分开的系统或部分接起来，使之作为一个整体运转的过程
senses.example: The integration of the ticketing and booking systems cut waiting lines in half.
senses.exampleCN: 售票与订票系统的整合让排队长龙减去一半。
senses.why: It is the noun of action of integrare, "to make whole".
senses.whyCN: 它是 integrare「使完整」这一动词的行为名词。

senses.title: People living together
senses.definition: the process by which different groups become full members of the same society
senses.definitionCN: 不同群体成为同一社会正式成员的过程
senses.example: Integration of newcomers works best when neighbours meet often.
senses.exampleCN: 新来者与邻居常来常往时，融合效果最好。
senses.why: The social sense grew after schools and workplaces were opened to everyone.
senses.whyCN: 社会义在学校与工作场所向所有人开放之后发展起来。

senses.title: Making markets and states one
senses.definition: the uniting of separate economies or regions into a single market or union
senses.definitionCN: 把分开的经济体或地区结成统一市场或联盟
senses.example: Economic integration made crossing the border a formality.
senses.exampleCN: 经济一体化让过境成了一道手续。
senses.why: Politicians took the word for treaties that bring neighbouring markets under one set of rules.
senses.whyCN: 政治家借这个词指把邻国市场纳入同一套规则的条约。

senses.title: In maths and science
senses.definition: the operation of adding up many small parts to get a total, or the total so found
senses.definitionCN: 把许多微小部分累加求得总量的运算，或由此求得的总量
senses.example: Learning integration comes after students master simple functions.
senses.exampleCN: 学生在掌握简单函数之后才学积分。
senses.why: Calculus uses the same metaphor: infinitely many thin strips sum to one whole area.
senses.whyCN: 微积分沿用同一比喻：无数细条累加成一块完整的面积。

intro.en: Integration is the Latin noun of action behind integrare; English borrowed it for both building and mathematics.
intro.cn: integration 是 integrare 背后的拉丁语行为名词，英语借来表达「整合」与数学上的「积分」。

items.en: Integer "whole, untouched" comes from in- "not" and a root meaning to touch.
items.cn: integer「完整的、未被触动的」来自 in-「不」与表示「触碰」的词根。

items.en: Integratio first named the restoring of a whole, including a person's health.
items.cn: integratio 最初指恢复完整，包括人的健康。

items.en: Seventeenth-century English used it for forming a whole out of parts.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语用它表示由部分构成整体。

items.en: Mathematicians then made it the name of summing small pieces into a total.
items.cn: 数学家随后让它成为把小块累加成总量的名称。

items.en: Modern social writing applies it to schools, nations, and migration.
items.cn: 现代的社会写作把它用于学校、国家与移民。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin whole; the near-meaning group names other ways of joining.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语「完整」；近义组列其他「结合」的方式。

entries.definition: Honesty and wholeness of character.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「正直；完整」，指品性。

entries.definition: The verb of joining into one whole.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使成为一体」。

entries.definition: A whole number in arithmetic.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「整数」。

entries.definition: Merging so completely that the parts lose their shape.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「融合」，各部分完全失去原形。

entries.definition: A joining of groups, often formal or political.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「联合」，多指正式或政治上的结合。

entries.definition: The combining of two companies into one.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「合并」，多指两家公司合成一家。

normalIntro.en: The hooks follow the whole-number root and the places where integration is actually discussed.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子沿着「完整」这一词根走，并附着在以 integration 为话题的场合上。

normal.en: Integer means whole: integration is the making of that whole.
normal.cn: integer 意为整：integration 就是把这个整做出来的过程。

normal.en: Bus routes, schools, and banks all talk about integration.
normal.cn: 公交线路、学校、银行都在谈整合。

normal.en: Economic integration means one market with one rulebook.
normal.cn: 经济一体化意味着一个市场、一套规则。

normal.en: Social integration needs friendship, not just laws.
normal.cn: 社会融合需要友谊，而不只是法律。

normal.en: Add up many small pieces and you get an integral.
normal.cn: 把许多小块累加，就得到一个积分。

abstract.en: Integration is the moment seams stop being visible.
abstract.cn: 整合就是接缝不再被人看见的那一刻。

abstract.en: A city is an integration of strangers into neighbours.
abstract.cn: 城市是把陌生人融合成邻居的过程。

abstract.en: Every whole is a promise that the pieces will stay together.
abstract.cn: 每个整体都是一份「各部分不散」的承诺。

examples.en: Integration of the two payroll systems saved a week of work each month.
examples.cn: 两套工资系统的整合每月省下一周的工作量。

examples.en: The city funds language classes to support broader integration.
examples.cn: 市政出资办语言班，以支持更广泛的融合。

examples.en: Full integration into the group takes most new members a term.
examples.cn: 大多数新成员要一个学期才能完全融入群体。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因太鬼雷神」——零件太奇特，靠雷神一把合成整体

root: 拉丁语 tangere「触碰」→ integer「完整的」（in-「不」+ 触碰）→ integrare「使完整」→ integratio「更新、使完整」→ 英语 integration。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: joining systems, bringing people together, uniting markets, and summing small parts in maths.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：整合系统、让群体融合、联合市场，以及数学上的求和积分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: small streams flow into one river and the sand bars disappear.
core.cn: 核心意象：小溪汇入大河，原来的沙洲消失。

branches.en: THE BUS MAP: two routes become one line.
branches.cn: 公交图这条线：两条线路变成一条。

branches.en: THE CLASSROOM: newcomers become ordinary neighbours.
branches.cn: 教室这条线：新来者变成平常的邻居。

branches.en: THE BORDER: markets merge under shared rules.
branches.cn: 边境这条线：市场在共同规则下合并。

branches.en: THE STRIPS: countless thin pieces add up to a whole area.
branches.cn: 细条这条线：无数细条累加成一整块面积。

branches.en: THE LINK: systems and people are both made whole by being joined.
branches.cn: 连接线：系统与人都是因被连接而变得完整。

intro.en: Integration = in- "not" + teg- "touch" + -ration, the noun ending -ation on the whole stem.
intro.cn: integration = in-「不」+ teg-「触碰」+ -ation，名词词尾加在整个词干上。

latinIntro.en: Latin integer, integrare and integratio are attested in classical texts.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 integer、integrare、integratio 在古典文献中均有记载。

items.exampleCN: 它给出「未被触动」的性质。

items.example: Also seen in intact and contact.
items.exampleCN: 也见于 intact 与 contact。

items.example: Whole numbers still carry the name.
It forms the noun of action.

items.exampleCN: 在 disintegration 中表示相反。

items.example: The reverse process has its own name.
items.exampleCN: 相反的过程有自己的名字。

definition_zh: 智力的；知识分子的；n. 知识分子
definition_en: relating to thinking and understanding, or a person who lives by ideas and study
core_image: 书桌上一摞书、一叠写满的字纸，窗外的声音都被关在玻璃外
scene: 书房里的人整晚没离开过椅子，桌上摊着好几本书和批注。Her intellectual curiosity took her from farming villages to a research library.
sceneCN: 这里 intellectual 是「智力的、求知方面的」（第 1 个义项：与思考理解有关），句意为求知的好奇心把她从农村带到研究图书馆。画面里的物件：摊开的书、批注笔、窗玻璃。

pos.zh: 形容词：智力的；脑力的；有才智的
名词：知识分子

derivatives.zh: 由本词的词干构成，义为「智力；才智」
由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「在智力上」
由同一拉丁词干构成，义为「智力；情报」
由同一词干构成，义为「可理解的」

senses.title: Of thinking and learning
senses.definition: concerned with the ability to think, reason, and understand rather than with the body
senses.definitionCN: 关乎思考、推理与理解的能力，而非身体
senses.example: Chess is an intellectual game played mostly in silence.
senses.exampleCN: 国际象棋是一种几乎在静默中进行的智力游戏。
senses.why: Latin intellegere means to pick out and understand; -ual marks a quality.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intellegere 意为「辨出并理解」，-ual 标出性质。

senses.title: Enjoying ideas
senses.definition: enjoying serious reading, discussion, and ideas for their own sake
senses.definitionCN: 以严肃的阅读、讨论与思考本身为乐
senses.example: Their conversations were intellectual and went on until dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的谈话富于思考，一直持续到天亮。
senses.why: By the eighteenth century the adjective described a lively taste for debate and learning.
senses.whyCN: 到十八世纪，这个形容词用来形容对辩论与学问的浓厚兴致。

senses.title: A person of ideas
senses.definition: a person, especially a well-known one, who writes or speaks seriously about ideas
senses.definitionCN: 尤指知名的人，认真写作或谈论思想的人
senses.example: The newspaper invited several intellectuals to argue about education.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸邀请了几位知识分子讨论教育问题。
senses.why: The noun use spread in the late nineteenth century, often with a faint hint of suspicion.
senses.whyCN: 名词用法在十九世纪末流行开来，往往略带一点怀疑的意味。

intro.en: Intellectual goes back to Latin intellegere, whose heart is legere "to choose, to read".
intro.cn: intellectual 上溯到拉丁语 intellegere，其核心是 legere「挑选、读」。

items.en: Legere meant to gather or pick, and so to read; inter- means "between, among".
items.cn: legere 意为「采集、挑」，因而「阅读」；inter- 意为「在……之间」。

items.en: Intellegere thus means to pick out the sense among things, that is, to understand.
items.cn: 因此 intellegere 意为在事物之间辨出意义，也就是理解。

items.en: Intellectualis was a later adjective used for the thinking part of the mind.
items.cn: intellectualis 是后期形容词，用于心灵中思考的那部分。

items.en: English adopted intellectual in the Middle Ages for what belongs to understanding.
items.cn: 英语在中世纪借入 intellectual，指属于理解力的东西。

items.en: The noun intellectual, a person of ideas, dates from the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 作名词表示「知识分子」的用法始于十九世纪。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the legere root; the near-meaning group holds other words about minds and thinking.
note.cn: 形近组共享 legere 词根；近义组收其他与头脑、思考有关的词。

entries.definition: The ability to learn, or secret information.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「智力」，也指情报。

entries.definition: Clear enough to be understood.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「明白易懂的」。

entries.definition: Good at learning and reasoning.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「聪明的」。

entries.definition: Connected with schools and formal study.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「学术的」，与学校、正规研究有关。

entries.definition: Careful and thorough in study, like a scholar.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「治学严谨的」。

entries.definition: Appealing to thought more than feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「诉诸思考的」，偏书卷气。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the legere root of reading and the real phrases around this adjective.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子利用「读」这一词根 legere，并挂上这个形容词的真实搭配。

normal.en: intellect plus -ual: the quality of understanding.
normal.cn: intellect 加 -ual：理解力的性质。

normal.en: Do not steal intellectual property; it belongs to its maker.
normal.cn: 不要盗取知识产权，它属于创造者。

normal.en: An intellectual lives on books, argument, and little sleep.
normal.cn: 知识分子靠书、辩论和很少的睡眠过活。

normal.en: The same root gives intelligence and intelligible.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 intelligence 与 intelligible。

normal.en: Intellectual work tires the mind, not the hands.
normal.cn: 脑力劳动累的是头脑，不是双手。

abstract.en: An intellectual is someone who cannot stop asking why.
abstract.cn: 知识分子是那种停不下问「为什么」的人。

abstract.en: Intellectual life is a conversation carried across centuries.
abstract.cn: 智识生活是一场跨越几个世纪的对话。

abstract.en: Thinking well is the quietest form of courage.
abstract.cn: 好好思考是最安静的一种勇气。

examples.en: He took an intellectual interest in how languages change.
examples.cn: 他对语言如何演变抱有学术上的兴趣。

examples.en: The magazine was written for a general intellectual audience.
examples.cn: 这本杂志是写给一般有学识的读者看的。

examples.en: She became a respected intellectual after publishing two books on law.
examples.cn: 发表两本法学著作后，她成了一位受人尊敬的知识分子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特莱克」——在因特网上猛查资料，成为知识分子

root: 拉丁语 legere「挑选、读」→ inter-「在……之间」+ legere → intellegere「辨出、理解」→ intellectualis「理解力的」→ 英语 intellectual。同族词：intellect、intelligence、intelligible。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: of the mind, fond of ideas, and as a noun, a person of ideas.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：属于头脑的、喜爱思想的，以及作名词指「知识分子」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp-lit desk piled with books while the street stays outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：台灯下的书桌堆满书，街道被关在外面。

branches.en: THE CHESSBOARD: the thinking part of a game is on show.
branches.cn: 棋盘这条线：展现的是游戏里思考的那部分。

branches.en: THE LONG TALK: ideas are enjoyed for their own sake.
branches.cn: 长谈这条线：为思想本身而享受思想。

branches.en: THE NEWSPAPER: named persons are asked to speak about ideas.
branches.cn: 报纸这条线：具名的人被请来谈思想。

branches.en: THE LINK: the quality and the person named after it.
branches.cn: 连接线：性质与其被命名的承载者。

branches.en: THE LINK: a taste for debate marks the type.
branches.cn: 连接线：爱辩论的趣味标出这一类人。

intro.en: Intellectual = inter- "among" + leg- "gather, read" + -ual "of the nature of".
intro.cn: intellectual = inter-「在……之间」+ leg-「采集、读」+ -ual「……性质的」。

latinIntro.en: Latin intellegere and intellectualis are both recorded forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intellegere 与 intellectualis 都是有记载的形式。

items.example: It puts the picking between things.
items.exampleCN: 它把「挑选」放在事物之间。

items.example: The root reappears in lecture and legend.
items.exampleCN: 词根也见于 lecture 与 legend。

items.example: The verb is the true ancestor.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是真正的祖先。

items.example: The English noun intellect comes from it.
items.exampleCN: 英语名词 intellect 来自它。
它构成这个抽象形容词。

items.example: The noun is shorter and older.

definition_zh: 智力；智慧；情报
definition_en: the ability to learn, understand, and reason, or secret information about an enemy
core_image: 有人在棋盘上看清十几步后的局面，同时有人把密信交到暗处
scene: 实验室里摆着拼图、棋子和一套做记录的量表，受试者正埋头解题。Tests of intelligence rarely capture how quickly a child learns.
sceneCN: 这里 intelligence 是「智力」（第 1 个义项：学习、理解与推理的能力），句意为智力测验很少能捕捉孩子学得多快。画面里的物件：拼图、棋子、记录表。

pos.zh: 名词：智力；智慧；情报

derivatives.zh: 由本词换后缀构成，义为「聪明的」
由 intelligent 加 -ly 构成，义为「明智地」
由词干加 -ible 构成，义为「可理解的」
由同一词干构成，义为「智力的」

senses.title: The power to learn and reason
senses.definition: the general ability to learn facts, understand ideas, and solve problems
senses.definitionCN: 学习事实、理解观念并解决问题的总体能力
senses.example: Her intelligence showed less in tests than in the questions she asked.
senses.exampleCN: 她的智力更多体现在提的问题里，而不是分数里。
senses.why: Latin intellegere, "to understand", gives the noun its core of understanding.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intellegere「理解」给这个名词以「理解」的内核。

senses.title: Secret information
senses.definition: information gathered about an enemy or rival, often secretly
senses.definitionCN: 常以秘密方式收集的关于敌方或对手的信息
senses.example: Naval intelligence warned the fleet two days ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 海军情报提前两天警告了舰队。
senses.why: This sense grew in military writing in the sixteenth century, where knowledge itself is a weapon.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项在十六世纪的军事写作中成长起来，在那里知识本身就是武器。

senses.title: A mind or being that knows
senses.definition: a thinking being, or in modern use a machine that seems to think
senses.definitionCN: 会思考的生灵，或现代用法中指看似会思考的机器
senses.example: Scientists argue about whether any machine intelligence can be friendly.
senses.exampleCN: 科学家在争论机器智能是否可能是友善的。
senses.why: The word shifts from a power to the possessor of that power.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从一种能力转向拥有这种能力的主体。

senses.title: News or information
senses.definition: formal or old-fashioned news about some event
senses.definitionCN: 关于某事的正式或旧式说法「消息」
senses.example: The family waited for intelligence from the frontier.
senses.exampleCN: 家人等着边疆传来的消息。
senses.why: The oldest English use simply meant tidings brought by a messenger.
senses.whyCN: 最早的英语用法只指信使带来的音信。

intro.en: Intelligence is the Latin noun intelligentia, built on intellegere "to understand".
intro.cn: intelligence 是拉丁语名词 intelligentia，建构在 intellegere「理解」之上。

items.en: Legere "to gather, read" with inter- "among" yields intellegere, "to pick out the sense".
items.cn: legere「采集、读」与 inter-「在……之间」合成 intellegere「辨出意义」。

items.en: Intelligentia named the power of understanding in classical philosophy.
items.cn: intelligentia 在古典哲学中指理解的能力。

items.en: French intelligence carried both understanding and news.
items.cn: 法语 intelligence 既指理解，也指消息。

items.en: English kept both senses; the news sense later narrowed to military and secret reports.
items.cn: 英语保留了两种意义；消息义后来窄化为军事与秘密报告。

items.en: The twentieth century added artificial intelligence and machine intelligence.
items.cn: 二十世纪添上了人工智能与机器智能的说法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the understanding root; the near-meaning group holds words about mental power.
note.cn: 形近组共享「理解」词根；近义组收表示心智能力的词。

entries.definition: The adjective for a person or animal that learns well.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容人或动物学习能力强。

entries.definition: The faculty of reasoning, in the abstract.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，抽象地指推理能力。

entries.definition: Able to be understood by the hearer.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「能被听懂看懂的」。

entries.definition: The same power seen as a separate faculty.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，把同一能力看作单独的官能。

entries.definition: Good judgement gained from experience, not speed.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「智慧」，来自经验而非反应快。

entries.definition: Facts of any kind, open or secret.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「信息」，公开或秘密的事实。

normalIntro.en: The hooks join the legere root of reading to the two faces of the word: mind and secret news.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把「读」这一词根 legere 与这个词的两张面孔合起来：心智与秘密消息。

normal.en: intellegere: to read among things means to understand them.
normal.cn: intellegere：在事物之间读懂，就是理解它们。

normal.en: Artificial intelligence is still only a clever reader of patterns.
normal.cn: 人工智能仍只是个会读图案的聪明角色。

normal.en: Military intelligence is information treated as a weapon.
normal.cn: 军事情报是被当作武器的信息。

normal.en: Intelligence tests measure only what tests can measure.
normal.cn: 智力测验只能测出测验能测的东西。

normal.en: The same root gives intelligent and intelligible.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 intelligent 与 intelligible。

abstract.en: Intelligence is the mind finding a path where none was drawn.
abstract.cn: 智力是头脑在没有路的地方找出路。

abstract.en: Knowing the enemy is half the battle, hence intelligence.
abstract.cn: 知敌者半胜，所以有情报之说。

abstract.en: A quiet question can show more intelligence than a quick answer.
abstract.cn: 一个安静的问题可能比一个快速回答更能显出智力。

examples.en: The puzzle is designed to test spatial intelligence.
examples.cn: 这个拼图用来测试空间智力。

examples.en: Intelligence from the coast reached the capital by noon.
examples.cn: 来自海岸的情报到正午已抵达首都。

examples.en: The firm hired her for her unusual social intelligence.
examples.cn: 这家公司聘她，是因为她不同寻常的社交智慧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特立先生」——那位先生脑子好，还掌握情报

root: 拉丁语 legere「采集、读」→ inter- + legere → intellegere「理解」→ intelligentia「理解力」→ 古法语 intelligence（理解；消息）→ 英语 intelligence。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: mental power, secret information, a thinking being, and old-fashioned news.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：心智能力、秘密情报、有智力的生灵，以及旧式的「消息」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one mind reads the whole board while a sealed note changes hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗头脑读透整盘棋，同时一封密封的纸条在暗中转手。

branches.en: THE TEST ROOM: puzzles measure how quickly a mind learns.
branches.cn: 测试室这条线：拼图衡量头脑学得多快。

branches.en: THE SEALED NOTE: knowledge about a rival is guarded.
branches.cn: 密信这条线：关于对手的知识被小心保守。

branches.en: THE MACHINE: a thinking being also takes the name.
branches.cn: 机器这条线：会思考的主体也用这个词。

branches.en: THE MESSENGER: plain news from far away.
branches.cn: 信使这条线：远方传来的普通消息。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses are knowledge put to use.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都是被派上用场的知识。

intro.en: Intelligence = inter- "between" + leg- "read" + -ence, a noun of state.
intro.cn: intelligence = inter-「在……之间」+ leg-「读」+ -ence，表示状态的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin intelligentia is recorded; the deeper layer alone is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intelligentia 有记载，只有更深一层属于重构。

items.example: It also appears in legend and lecture.
items.exampleCN: 也见于 legend 与 lecture。

items.example: The verb is the family base.

definition_zh: 聪明的；智能的；明智的
definition_en: good at learning, understanding, and thinking clearly, or able to act in a sensible way
core_image: 一只鸟衔起小枝把够不到的虫子勾出来，旁边的人看呆了
scene: 实验台前的乌鸦把树枝折弯，伸进细管里把食物钩了出来。A truly intelligent answer often starts with a good question.
sceneCN: 这里 intelligent 是「聪明的」（第 1 个义项：学习与理解能力强），句意为真正聪明的答案常从一个好问题开始。画面里的物件：折弯的树枝、细管、食物。

pos.zh: 形容词：聪明的；智能的；明智的

derivatives.zh: 由本词换后缀构成，义为「智力；情报」
由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「明智地」
由否定前缀 un- 加本词构成，义为「不聪明的」
由同一词干构成，义为「可理解的」

senses.title: Quick to learn
senses.definition: able to learn and understand things quickly and well
senses.definitionCN: 能够又快又好地学习和理解事物
senses.example: The raven was intelligent enough to bend a twig into a hook.
senses.exampleCN: 那只乌鸦聪明得能把细枝折成钩子。
senses.why: It is the present participle of the Latin verb meaning to understand.
senses.whyCN: 它是拉丁语「理解」这一动词的现在分词。

senses.title: Sensible in judgement
senses.definition: showing good judgement rather than mere knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 表现出好的判断力，而不只是知识多
senses.example: It was intelligent of them to leave before the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在暴风雨前离开，很明智。
senses.why: Knowledge is not enough; the word also praises wise choices.
senses.whyCN: 只有知识还不够，这个词也用来称赞明智的选择。

senses.title: Of machines and systems
senses.definition: designed to respond to information and act without a person giving each step
senses.definitionCN: 设计成能对信息作出反应、无需人逐步指挥就能行动
senses.example: The heating is controlled by an intelligent system that learns your habits.
senses.exampleCN: 供暖由一套了解你习惯的智能系统控制。
senses.why: Modern engineering borrowed the word for devices that behave as if they think.
senses.whyCN: 现代工程借这个词形容那些表现得像会思考的装置。

intro.en: Intelligent is the Latin participle of intellegere, "to understand", and came into English through French.
intro.cn: intelligent 是拉丁语 intellegere「理解」的分词，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Legere "to gather, read" plus inter- "among" makes intellegere, to pick out the sense.
items.cn: legere「采集、读」加 inter-「在……之间」构成 intellegere，意为辨出意义。

items.en: The participle intelligens described someone who grasps what is going on.
items.cn: 分词 intelligens 形容一个把握得住事理的人。

items.en: French intelligent carried both the learning and the judgement senses.
items.cn: 法语 intelligent 兼带「会学」与「会判断」两层意思。

items.en: English adopted it in the Middle Ages as an adjective of praise for people.
items.cn: 英语在中世纪借入它，作为称赞人的形容词。

items.en: Twentieth-century technology extended it to machines, from thermostats to phones.
items.cn: 二十世纪的技术把它扩展到机器上，从恒温器到手机。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the understanding root; the near-meaning group holds other words for being clever.
note.cn: 形近组共享「理解」词根；近义组收其他表示「聪明」的词。

entries.definition: The noun for learning power or secret news.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为智力或情报。

entries.definition: Concerned with ideas and study.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「智力的；知识的」。

entries.definition: Clear and understandable.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「明白易懂的」。

entries.definition: Quick at finding tricks and solutions.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「机灵的」，善于找窍门。

entries.definition: Bright and quick, often in a practical or modern way.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「聪明机灵的」，常偏实用或时髦。

entries.definition: Skilful in judging deep matters with experience.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有智慧的」，靠经验判断。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the legere root and the company this adjective keeps.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子用「读」这一词根 legere，并借助这个形容词的常见搭配。

normal.en: intelligent holds the same middle as intelligence: the seeing mind.
normal.cn: intelligent 中间那段与 intelligence 相同，都是「会看的脑子」。

normal.en: An intelligent person can be wrong; a wise one learns from it.
normal.cn: 聪明人会犯错，有智慧的人会从错误里学。

normal.en: Intelligent software is still trained by people.
normal.cn: 智能软件仍要由人来训练。

normal.en: It was intelligent to read the contract twice.
normal.cn: 把合同读两遍是明智的。

normal.en: Animals are more intelligent than our tests admit.
normal.cn: 动物比我们的测验所承认的更聪明。

abstract.en: Being intelligent is knowing what matters and what does not.
abstract.cn: 聪明就是知道什么要紧、什么不要紧。

abstract.en: An intelligent question opens a door that a clever answer closes.
abstract.cn: 聪明的问题推开一扇门，机巧的答案却把它关上。

abstract.en: The word praises both speed of mind and steadiness of judgement.
abstract.cn: 这个词既赞头脑快，也赞判断稳。

examples.en: She is intelligent and unusually patient with beginners.
examples.cn: 她聪明，而且对初学者格外有耐心。

examples.en: Bees show intelligent behaviour when they search a new garden.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂到新花园觅食时表现出颇具智能的行为。

examples.en: The most intelligent move was to say nothing.
examples.cn: 最明智的举动是一言不发。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特立准特」——脑子灵到每次都判断得特准

root: 拉丁语 legere「读、采集」→ inter- + legere → intellegere「理解」→ intelligens（现在分词）→ 法语 intelligent → 英语 intelligent。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: quick to learn, wise in judgement, and machine intelligence.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：学得快、判断明智，以及机器具有的智能。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bird bends a twig to reach food it could not touch.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只鸟把细枝折弯，够到原本碰不到的食物。

branches.en: THE RAVEN: learning happens in front of your eyes.
branches.cn: 乌鸦这条线：学习就发生在眼前。

branches.en: THE WISE CHOICE: leaving early beats knowing more.
branches.cn: 明智选择这条线：早点离开胜过知道更多。

branches.en: THE SMART HOME: a device acts as if it thinks.
branches.cn: 智能家居这条线：设备像是会思考。

branches.en: THE LINK: learning well lets one judge well.
branches.cn: 连接线：学得好才判断得好。

branches.en: THE LINK: the machine only imitates the first sense.
branches.cn: 连接线：机器只是模仿第一个义项。

intro.en: Intelligent = inter- "among" + leg- "read" + -ent, a participle ending.
intro.cn: intelligent = inter-「在……之间」+ leg-「读」+ -ent（分词词尾）。

latinIntro.en: Latin intellegere and intelligens are documented forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intellegere 与 intelligens 都是有文献的形式。

items.exampleCN: 也见于 legend 与 lecture。

items.example: The verb is the trunk of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是词族的主干。

items.example: It gives the adjective its shape.
items.exampleCN: 它给形容词以现在的形态。

items.example: A different ending changes the point of view.

definition_zh: 打算；想要；意为
definition_en: to have a plan or purpose in mind, or to be meant for a particular use
core_image: 弓弦被拉紧，箭尖指向远处的一点，手还没松开
scene: 院子里搭了一半的木架，工具摆在地上，主人正看着图纸。We intend to finish the fence before the first frost.
sceneCN: 这里 intend 是「打算」（第 1 个义项：心里已有计划），句意为我们打算在第一场霜前把篱笆修完。画面里的物件：半成品木架、工具、图纸。

pos.zh: 动词：打算；意图；意为

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「意图；打算」
由同一词干构成，义为「意图」；也作形容词「专注的」
由过去分词转作形容词，义为「预期的；预定的」
由否定前缀 un- 加过去分词构成，义为「非故意的」

senses.title: Plan to do something
senses.definition: to have something in mind as a plan or purpose
senses.definitionCN: 把某事件作为计划或目的放在心上
senses.example: They intend to move the shop closer to the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他们打算把店搬到离车站更近的地方。
senses.why: Latin intendere means to stretch towards, like a bow aimed at a mark.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intendere 意为「朝……伸展」，像弓瞄准靶子。

senses.title: Mean something by words
senses.definition: to mean a particular thing by what one says or does
senses.definitionCN: 指通过言语或行为想表达某个特定的意思
senses.example: I intended a warning, not a joke.
senses.exampleCN: 我想表达的是警告，不是玩笑。
senses.why: Mind is a kind of aim: words are arrows shot at a hearer's understanding.
senses.whyCN: 心意也是一种瞄准：话是射向听者理解的箭。

senses.title: Be meant for a use
senses.definition: to be planned or designed for a particular person or purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为某个人或某种目的而规划或设计
senses.example: The small room was intended for the children.
senses.exampleCN: 这个小房间是为孩子们准备的。
senses.why: The passive form focuses on the target of the aim rather than on the planner.
senses.whyCN: 被动形式把注意力从计划者移到被瞄准的用途上。

intro.en: Intend comes from Latin intendere "to stretch towards", the same verb that gives tension and attention.
intro.cn: intend 来自拉丁语 intendere「朝……伸展」，与 tension、attention 同一动词。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" joined in- "towards" to make intendere.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」与 in-「朝向」合成 intendere。

items.en: Archers used intendere arcum, to bend a bow, always aiming at something.
items.cn: 弓箭手用 intendere arcum 表示「弯弓」，总是指向某物。

items.en: The noun intentio named the act of aiming the mind.
items.cn: 名词 intentio 指让心瞄准的动作。

items.en: French entendre "to mean, to understand" carried the word into English.
items.cn: 法语 entendre（意为、听懂）把这个词带入英语。

items.en: English fixed the spelling intend and the contrast with intend versus attend.
items.cn: 英语固定了拼写 intend，并与 attend 形成对照。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tendere root of stretching; the near-meaning group holds other words for planning.
note.cn: 形近组共享表示「伸展」的词根 tendere；近义组收其他表示计划的词。

entries.definition: The noun for purpose; the adjective for being focused.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「意图」，形容词义为「专注的」。

entries.definition: To stretch something out or forward.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「伸展；延长」。

entries.definition: To stretch the mind towards a meeting or a task.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「出席」，原指把心伸向某事。

entries.definition: To arrange the steps of a future action.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「计划」，安排未来行动的步骤。

entries.definition: To have something as one's purpose by nature.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「意欲」，侧重语言本身所指。

entries.definition: To point at a target, literally or figuratively.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「瞄准；旨在」，字面或比喻皆可。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the stretched bow inside the word and its habitual phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子利用词里那张拉开的弓以及它的习惯搭配。

normal.en: in plus tend: stretch the mind towards a target.
normal.cn: in 加 tend：把心思朝靶子伸过去。

normal.en: We intend to finish early, and as intended we do.
normal.cn: 我们打算早点完成，也如预期完成了。

normal.en: The knife is intended for bread, not for wood.
normal.cn: 这把刀是为切面包准备的，不是砍木头的。

normal.en: Intend has a plan; attention has a focus.
normal.cn: intend 是有计划，attention 是有焦点。

normal.en: He intended no harm, only a quiet warning.
normal.cn: 他并无恶意，只是想轻声警告。

abstract.en: To intend is to draw a bow before saying a word.
abstract.cn: 打算就是在开口前先把弓拉开。

abstract.en: An intention is an arrow released only half way.
abstract.cn: 意图是一支只射出一半的箭。

abstract.en: People judge the deed, while you remember the aim.
abstract.cn: 别人评判行为，你自己记得当初的瞄准。

examples.en: We intend to keep the old sign over the door.
examples.cn: 我们打算把门上那块旧招牌留着。

examples.en: She intended her remark as a warning, not an insult.
examples.cn: 她那句话是想提醒，而不是侮辱。

examples.en: The path was intended for walkers, not bicycles.
examples.cn: 这条小路是为步行者修的，不是给自行车的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因疼的」——还没动手就先因想着而心疼，那是打算

root: 拉丁语 tendere「伸展」→ in-「朝向」+ tendere → intendere「朝……伸展、瞄准」→ 古法语 entendre → 英语 intend。同族词：intention、intent、extend、attend。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: planning to act, meaning a certain thing, and being designed for a purpose.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：计划去做、话里想要表达，以及为某用途而设定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drawn bow aimed at a distant mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张拉满的弓指向远处的靶点。

branches.en: THE PLAN: the bow is drawn for tomorrow's task.
branches.cn: 计划这条线：为明天的任务拉开的弓。

branches.en: THE REMARK: words are aimed at a hearer's mind.
branches.cn: 话语这条线：话瞄准听者的头脑。

branches.en: THE SMALL ROOM: a space is aimed at one kind of user.
branches.cn: 小房间这条线：空间瞄准某一类使用者。

branches.en: THE LINK: both are aims inside a mind.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都是心里的瞄准。

branches.en: THE LINK: what is planned is also what is designed.
branches.cn: 连接线：所打算的也正是所设计的。

intro.en: Intend = in- "towards" + the root tend- "stretch", with no separate English suffix.
intro.cn: intend = in-「朝向」+ 词根 tend-「伸展」，没有单独的英语后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin tendere, intendere and intentio are all attested.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tendere、intendere、intentio 均有记载。

items.exampleCN: 也见于 tension 与 tendon。

items.example: The verb alone means to stretch out.
It is the noun behind intention.
items.exampleCN: 它是 intention 背后的名词。

definition_zh: 强烈的；剧烈的；紧张的；热情的
definition_en: very great or extreme in strength, feeling, or degree
core_image: 灯丝被拧到最亮，光晕几乎要把镜头烧白
scene: 舞台上只剩一束聚光灯，演员额头冒汗，观众连呼吸都放轻了。The heat in the small kitchen was so intense that the windows steamed up.
sceneCN: 这里 intense 是「强烈的、极度的」（第 1 个义项：强度极大），句意小厨房里热得厉害，窗户都起了雾。画面里的物件：聚光灯、额头的汗、起雾的窗。

pos.zh: 形容词：强烈的；剧烈的；紧张的；热情的

derivatives.zh: 由本词换后缀构成，义为「强度；强烈」
由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「强烈地」
由本词加 -ify 构成，义为「加强；加剧」
由同一词干构成，义为「紧张；内涵」

senses.title: Very strong in degree
senses.definition: extremely great in strength, force, or amount
senses.definitionCN: 在力度、力量或数量上极其之大
senses.example: The midday sun was so intense that the paint cracked.
senses.exampleCN: 中午的太阳太烈，油漆都裂开了。
senses.why: Latin intensus is the participle of intendere, "stretched tight".
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intensus 是 intendere「绷紧」的分词。

senses.title: Deeply felt
senses.definition: felt very strongly, as of feelings, interest, or dislike
senses.definitionCN: 指情感、兴趣或厌恶等感受非常强烈
senses.example: She has an intense love of mountain air.
senses.exampleCN: 她极爱山里的空气。
senses.why: The same tightness is applied to feeling: emotions can be stretched to their limit.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「绷紧」被用到情感上：情绪也会绷到极限。

senses.title: Serious and concentrated
senses.definition: very serious, busy, and demanding of attention
senses.definitionCN: 非常严肃、繁忙，要求全神贯注
senses.example: The weeks before the exam were intense for everyone in the class.
senses.exampleCN: 考前那几周全班人都很紧张。
senses.why: Work and study borrow the word for a stretched state with no slack left.
senses.whyCN: 工作与学习借这个词形容毫无余裕的绷紧状态。

senses.title: Extreme in a worrying way
senses.definition: so extreme as to be frightening or unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 极端到令人害怕或不快的程度
senses.example: The attack drew intense criticism from the town council.
senses.exampleCN: 那次攻击引来市议会猛烈的批评。
senses.why: Tightness can be unpleasant: stretched too far, strength becomes a threat.
senses.whyCN: 绷得太紧便会不好受：力量过头就成了威胁。

intro.en: Intense is a Latin participle of intendere "to stretch towards", so its core is tightness.
intro.cn: intense 是拉丁语 intendere「朝……伸展」的分词，因此其核心是「绷紧」。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" with in- "towards" yields intendere, to strain forward.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」与 in-「朝向」构成 intendere「向前绷紧」。

items.en: Intensus described a bow or string pulled tight.
items.cn: intensus 形容被拉得很紧的弓或弦。

items.en: Late Latin extended the participle to light, heat, and emotions that reach a peak.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语把这个分词扩展到达到顶点的光、热与情感。

items.en: French intense narrowed the meaning to things very great in degree.
items.cn: 法语 intense 把意义窄化为「程度极大之事」。

items.en: English uses intense for heat, pressure, feeling, and, loosely, for earnest people.
items.cn: 英语用 intense 形容热、压力、感受，口语中也形容过于认真的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the stretched root; the near-meaning group holds other words for great strength.
note.cn: 形近组共享「绷紧」词根；近义组收表示「强度大」的词。

entries.definition: Concentrated on one task, such as a course.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「集中的、强化的」，如强化课程。

entries.definition: The measurable strength of heat, light or feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「强度」，可测量的量。

entries.definition: Purpose, or else fixed and absorbed.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「意图」，形容词义为「专注的」。

entries.definition: Violent and angry, often of animals or weather.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「凶猛的」，多指动物或天气。

entries.definition: Sharp and strong, often of pain or problems.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「剧烈的」，多形容疼痛或问题。

entries.definition: Great in feeling or seriousness rather than force.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，偏指情感或程度之深，而非力量之大。

normalIntro.en: The hooks hang on the image of a string pulled to its limit.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子挂在「绳子拉到极限」这一画面上。

normal.en: Intense is a string with no slack left.
normal.cn: intense 就是一根再没有余量的弦。

normal.en: Intense heat, intense pressure, intense competition: the word adds a peak.
normal.cn: 酷热、巨大压力、激烈竞争：这个词都添上一个「顶点」。

normal.en: Intensity is what intense measures.
normal.cn: intensity 是 intense 所衡量的那个量。

normal.en: Intensive study is short and hard; intense study feels full of pressure.
normal.cn: intensive 学习短而猛，intense 学习则是压得满满。

normal.en: An intense person is rarely bored.
normal.cn: 性格强烈的人很少觉得无聊。

abstract.en: Intensity is a fire you cannot look away from.
abstract.cn: 强度是一团你无法转开视线的火。

abstract.en: Anything stretched too long returns changed.
abstract.cn: 任何拉得过久的东西回来时都变了样。

abstract.en: The word asks not how much, but how tight.
abstract.cn: 这个词不问多少，只问绷得多紧。

examples.en: The pressure before the launch was intense.
examples.cn: 发射前的压力非常大。

examples.en: He felt an intense dislike of crowded rooms.
examples.cn: 他对拥挤的房间有强烈的厌恶。

examples.en: Competition for the scholarship is intense this year.
examples.cn: 今年奖学金的竞争十分激烈。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因太死」——绷得太死太紧，所以强度极高

root: 拉丁语 tendere「伸展」→ in- + tendere → intendere「朝前绷紧」→ 分词 intensus「拉紧的」→ 古法语 intense → 英语 intense。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: extreme degree, deep feeling, tense work, and unpleasant violence.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：程度极高、情感浓烈、工作紧张，以及令人不适的猛烈。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a filament turned to full brightness.
core.cn: 核心意象：灯丝被开到最亮。

branches.en: THE SUN AT NOON: heat and light reach their peak.
branches.cn: 正午太阳这条线：热与光达到顶点。

branches.en: THE LOVED AIR: feeling is stretched to its edge.
branches.cn: 山间空气这条线：情感被拉到边缘。

branches.en: THE EXAM WEEK: attention has no slack left.
branches.cn: 考试周这条线：注意力毫无余裕。

branches.en: THE HARSH ATTACK: strength turns into threat.
branches.cn: 猛烈攻击这条线：力量变为威胁。

branches.en: THE LINK: both describe being pushed near a limit.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都形容被推到接近极限。

intro.en: Intense = in- "towards" + tens- "stretch" + -e, with the Latin participle ending dropped.
intro.cn: intense = in-「朝向」+ tens-「伸展」+ -e，拉丁分词词尾已脱落。

latinIntro.en: Latin intendere and intensus are recorded; English remodelled the ending.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intendere 与 intensus 有记载，英语改铸了词尾。

items.example: It gives direction to the stretch.

items.exampleCN: 也见于 tension 与 tensor。

definition_zh: 强烈；剧烈；强度
definition_en: the strength or degree of something such as heat, light, sound, or feeling
core_image: 调音台上的推子被推到顶，音量指示灯全部亮红
scene: 录音室墙上挂着一块表，指针随鼓声忽高忽低地跳动。Engineers measure the intensity of the sound at the front row.
sceneCN: 这里 intensity 是「强度」（第 1 个义项：可衡量的强弱程度），句意为工程师测量前排声音的强度。画面里的物件：音量表、推子、指示灯。

pos.zh: 名词：强度；强烈；剧烈

derivatives.zh: 由本词换后缀构成，义为「强烈的」
由本词换后缀构成，义为「加强；加剧」
由同一词干构成，义为「集中的；密集的」
由 intensify 加 -ion 构成，义为「加强」

senses.title: Measured strength
senses.definition: the amount of energy carried by heat, light, or sound, which can be measured
senses.definitionCN: 热、光或声音所携带、可以测量的能量多少
senses.example: The intensity of the lamp was turned down for the evening reading.
senses.exampleCN: 晚上读书时把灯的亮度调低了。
senses.why: Latin intensus "stretched" plus -ity makes a noun of degree.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intensus「拉紧的」加 -ity 构成表示程度的抽象名词。

senses.title: Strength of feeling
senses.definition: the depth and force of an emotion or of an experience
senses.definitionCN: 情感或经历所具有的深度与力度
senses.example: The intensity of her grief surprised her friends.
senses.exampleCN: 她悲伤之深让朋友们吃惊。
senses.why: Feelings are treated like light: they can be dim or blinding.
senses.whyCN: 情感被当作光来对待：可以昏淡，也可以刺目。

senses.title: Serious effort
senses.definition: great concentration and effort in work, study, or sport
senses.definitionCN: 在工作、学习或运动中投入的高度专注与气力
senses.example: The team trained with an intensity it had never shown.
senses.exampleCN: 这支队伍以从未有过的强度训练。
senses.why: The word praises not long hours but the grip of full attention.
senses.whyCN: 这个词赞的不是时数长，而是全神贯注的紧握感。

senses.title: In physics
senses.definition: the power carried through a unit area or a unit solid angle
senses.definitionCN: 单位面积或单位立体角所通过的能量
senses.example: Laser intensity falls off with the square of distance.
senses.exampleCN: 激光强度随距离的平方下降。
senses.why: Physics made the everyday word exact: power divided by area.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把这个日常词精确化：能量除以面积。

intro.en: Intensity attaches the Latin ending -itas to intensus, the participle of intendere.
intro.cn: intensity 把拉丁词尾 -itas 加到 intendere 的分词 intensus 上。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" with in- makes intendere, to strain towards.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」与 in- 构成 intendere「向前绷紧」。

items.en: Intensus, the participle, described anything pulled tight.
items.cn: 分词 intensus 形容任何被拉紧之物。

items.en: Late Latin intesitas named the quality of being stretched to a high degree.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 intesitas 指被拉到高度这一性质。

items.en: French intensité was borrowed by English scientists in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 十七世纪英国科学家借入了法语 intensité。

items.en: It became a measuring term in physics and a praise word for feeling and effort.
items.cn: 它在物理学中成为测量术语，也成为赞感受与投入的词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the stretched root; the near-meaning group holds other words for strength.
note.cn: 形近组共享「绷紧」词根；近义组收表示力量的词。

entries.definition: The adjective; the feeling itself is intense.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，感受本身是强烈的。

entries.definition: Gathered on one point, as in intensive care.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，集中于一点，如加护病房。

entries.definition: The state of being stretched, or nervous strain.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「张力；紧张」。

entries.definition: General power, often of a person or a material.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，泛指力量，多形容人或材料。

entries.definition: Physical power that moves or breaks things.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「力」，能推动或破坏的物理力量。

entries.definition: A step on a scale, the neutral word for amount.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「程度」，中性的量度说法。

normalIntro.en: The hooks attach the -ity of measurement to the tightened string.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把表示「度量」的 -ity 挂在绷紧的弦上。

normal.en: Intense is the adjective; intensity is the dial you can read.
normal.cn: intense 是形容词，intensity 是可以读出刻度的表盘。

normal.en: Light intensity, sound intensity, emotional intensity: all are amounts.
normal.cn: 光照强度、声音强度、情感强度，都是量。

normal.en: High intensity training is short and hard.
normal.cn: 高强度训练短而费力。

normal.en: The intensity of the storm grew after dark.
normal.cn: 天黑之后暴风雨的强度增大了。

normal.en: Turn the intensity down when the neighbours sleep.
normal.cn: 邻居睡觉时把强度调低。

abstract.en: Intensity is how bright a thing burns, not how long.
abstract.cn: 强度是烧得多亮，而不是烧得多久。

abstract.en: A small room can hold great intensity of feeling.
abstract.cn: 一间小屋也能盛下极浓的情感。

abstract.en: Measure the light, and you still have not measured the evening.
abstract.cn: 量出了光的强度，你仍没有量出那个夜晚。

examples.en: The intensity of the midday light hurt his eyes.
examples.cn: 正午光线的强度刺痛了他的眼睛。

examples.en: She spoke with an intensity that silenced the room.
examples.cn: 她说话时的强度让全场安静下来。

examples.en: Doctors lowered the intensity of the treatment after a week.
examples.cn: 一周后医生降低了治疗的强度。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因太深斯特」——绷得太深太紧，强度自然大

root: 拉丁语 tendere「伸展」→ intensus「拉紧的」→ 晚期拉丁语 intesitas「绷紧的性质」→ 法语 intensité → 英语 intensity。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: measurable power, depth of feeling, concentrated effort, and the physics term.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：可测的力量、情感的深度、集中的投入，以及物理术语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fader pushed to the top and lights burning red.
core.cn: 核心意象：推子推到顶端，指示灯全红。

branches.en: THE LAMP: brightness is turned up or down.
branches.cn: 台灯这条线：亮度可以调高调低。

branches.en: THE GRIEF: feeling is measured like light.
branches.cn: 悲伤这条线：情感像光一样被度量。

branches.en: THE TRAINING GROUND: effort is held at full grip.
branches.cn: 训练场这条线：用力维持在满握状态。

branches.en: THE LASER: power divided by area, made exact.
branches.cn: 激光这条线：能量除以面积，精确化。

branches.en: THE LINK: everyday and scientific strength share one word.
branches.cn: 连接线：日常与科学的强度共用一词。

intro.en: Intensity = in- + tens- "stretch" + -ity "the quality of".
intro.cn: intensity = in- + tens-「伸展」+ -ity「……的性质」。

latinIntro.en: Latin intensus and the late form intesitas are both recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intensus 与晚期形式 intesitas 均有记载。

definition_zh: 加强的；集中的；密集的；精耕细作的
definition_en: involving a lot of effort, work, or attention in a short period, or concentrated on one area
core_image: 一小块地里插满了苗，水和肥料都浇到同几垄上
scene: 教室里只有六个人，两周内每天八节课，教材翻到了最后几页。The hospital opened a new intensive care unit on the top floor.
sceneCN: 这里 intensive 是「加强的、密集的」（第 1 个义项：短期投入大量精力），句意医院在顶层新开了重症监护病房，即集中照护的地方。画面里的物件：教材、病区指示牌、护理记录。

pos.zh: 形容词：加强的；集中的；密集的；精耕细作的

derivatives.zh: 由同一词干构成，义为「强度」
由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「密集地」
由同一词干加 -ify 构成，义为「加强」
由同一词干构成，义为「强烈的」

senses.title: Concentrated in time
senses.definition: involving much effort and attention in a short period
senses.definitionCN: 在短期内投入大量精力与注意力
senses.example: The students took an intensive course in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们在夏天上了一个强化课程。
senses.why: The suffix -ive means "tending to", so intensive describes effort gathered onto one point.
senses.whyCN: -ive 意为「倾向于」，因此 intensive 形容力量聚于一点。

senses.title: Of land and farming
senses.definition: using a lot of labour, water, and fertilizer on a small area of land
senses.definitionCN: 在小面积土地上投入大量人工、水与肥料
senses.example: Intensive farming feeds more people from fewer fields.
senses.exampleCN: 集约农业用更少的田地养活更多的人。
senses.why: Agriculture borrowed the idea of effort concentrated on one plot.
senses.whyCN: 农业借用了「精力集中于一小块地」这一想法。

senses.title: Of medical care
senses.definition: giving constant close attention to a seriously ill patient
senses.definitionCN: 对危重病人给予持续的密切照护
senses.example: She spent a week in intensive care after the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 事故后她在重症监护病房住了一周。
senses.why: Hospitals needed a word for care with no moment left unattended.
senses.whyCN: 医院需要一个词来形容每一刻都不放空的照护。

senses.title: Grammar: adding force
senses.definition: added to a word to strengthen it, as very does
senses.definitionCN: 加在词上以加强语气，如 very 的作用
senses.example: The adverb is used here as an intensive word.
senses.exampleCN: 这里这个副词起了强调作用。
senses.why: Grammarians applied the same metaphor to words that press harder.
senses.whyCN: 语法学家把同一比喻用到了「加力」的词上。

intro.en: Intensive adds the Latin ending -ivus "tending to" to the participle of intendere.
intro.cn: intensive 在 intendere 的分词上加拉丁词尾 -ivus「倾向于」。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" with in- gives intendere, to strain towards something.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」加 in- 构成 intendere「向某物绷紧」。

items.en: Intensus was the past participle, used of a drawn bow or attentive mind.
items.cn: intensus 是过去分词，用于拉开的弓或专注的心。

items.en: The ending -ivus marked a tendency or direction of action.
items.cn: 词尾 -ivus 标出动作的倾向或方向。

items.en: English formed intensive in the seventeenth century for effort gathered in one place.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪造出 intensive，指力量集于一处。

items.en: Farming, medicine, and language teaching each adopted it in turn.
items.cn: 农业、医学与语言教学先后各自采用了它。

note.en: The look-alike group differs from intense only by the ending; the near-meaning group holds words for concentrated effort.
note.cn: 形近组与 intense 只差词尾；近义组收表示集中投入的词。

entries.definition: Very strong in degree, of heat or feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指程度强烈，多用于热或感受。

entries.definition: The measured strength of something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为可测量的强度。

entries.definition: Covering a wide area rather than a deep point.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「广泛的」，铺开而非集中。

entries.definition: Complete in every part, with nothing skipped.

normalIntro.en: The hooks lean on the difference between intensive and intense and on real course names.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子利用 intensive 与 intense 的差别，也借助真实的课程名称。

normal.en: Intensive work is piled into days; intense work merely feels extreme.
normal.cn: intensive 是几天里塞满活儿，intense 只是感觉极端。

normal.en: An intensive course trades length for density.
normal.cn: 强化课程用短时间换高密度。

normal.en: Intensive care watches every breath.
normal.cn: 重症监护盯着每一次呼吸。

normal.en: Intensive farming squeezes more from one field.
normal.cn: 集约农业从一块地里挤出更多产出。

normal.en: Intensive reading takes ten pages slowly.
normal.cn: 精读就是很慢地读十页。

abstract.en: Intensive means one spot held under a burning glass.
abstract.cn: 密集就是以燃烧的透镜照住一处。

abstract.en: Not wider, only deeper: that is the intensive way.
abstract.cn: 不求更宽，只求更深，这就是密集的路子。

abstract.en: Some learning must be pressed, like coffee.
abstract.cn: 有些学习必须像咖啡一样被压实。

examples.en: He signed up for a four-week intensive German course.
examples.cn: 他报了一个四周的德语强化课程。

examples.en: Intensive training left the team strong but tired.
examples.cn: 密集训练让队伍变强，也很疲惫。

examples.en: The farmer turned his small plot into intensive rice fields.
examples.cn: 这位农民把小地块改成了精耕稻田。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: short concentrated effort, farming, medical care, and grammar.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：短期集中投入、农业经营、医疗照护，以及语法上的强调。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small plot crowded with seedlings and watched every day.

branches.cn: 暑期课程这条线：课时塞进几周里。

branches.en: THE SMALL FIELD: land is worked hard, not widely.
branches.cn: 小田块这条线：地是精耕的，不是铺开的。

branches.en: THE WARD: attention never lets go of the patient.
branches.cn: 病房这条线：注意力一刻不离病人。

branches.en: THE STRESS WORD: a little very presses the meaning harder.
branches.cn: 强调词这条线：一个小小的 very 把意思压得更重。

branches.en: THE LINK: both spend attention in a narrow, constant way.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都把注意力窄而持续地投下去。

definition_zh: 意图；目的；adj. 专注的；坚决的
definition_en: a purpose or aim, or being firmly fixed on doing something
core_image: 一双眼睛盯住门口的动静，肩膀一动不动
scene: 猫伏在门口，耳朵贴着门缝，一动不动地等那阵脚步声。Her intent was never to embarrass him, only to warn him.
sceneCN: 这里 intent 是「意图」（第 1 个义项：心里想达到的目的），句意她的意图从不是让他难堪，只是提醒他。画面里的物件：门缝、猫的耳朵、静止的肩膀。

pos.zh: 名词：意图；目的
形容词：专注的；坚决的

senses.title: Purpose behind an act
senses.definition: the purpose or aim that lies behind what someone does
senses.definitionCN: 某人行为背后的目的或目标
senses.example: The court asked whether there was intent to defraud.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭追问是否有欺诈的意图。
senses.why: Latin intentus, the participle of intendere, hardened into a noun for a fixed aim.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语分词 intentus 硬化为表示「既定目标」的名词。

senses.title: Fixed attention
senses.definition: giving all your attention to something, often with the body still
senses.definitionCN: 把全部注意力放在某物上，身体往往一动不动
senses.example: The children were intent on the magician's hands.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们紧盯着魔术师的手。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the physical image of a stretched, unmoving posture.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词保留了「绷紧、不动」的身体形象。

senses.title: Firmly determined
senses.definition: strongly determined to do something and unlikely to be turned aside
senses.definitionCN: 坚决要做某事，不易被劝开
senses.example: He was intent on finishing the climb before dark.
senses.exampleCN: 他一心要在天黑前登顶。
senses.why: Determination is an aim that will not let the mind relax.
senses.whyCN: 决心是那个不让心思松下来的目标。

intro.en: Intent is the Latin participle of intendere used as a noun and an adjective in English.
intro.cn: intent 是拉丁语 intendere 的分词，在英语中兼作名词与形容词。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" with in- "towards" gives intendere, to aim the mind.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」与 in-「朝向」构成 intendere「把心瞄向某处」。

items.en: The participle intensus described a mind or a bow held taut.
items.cn: 分词 intensus 形容绷紧的心或弓。

items.en: Legal Latin used intentio for the aim that gives an act its character.
items.cn: 法律拉丁语用 intentio 指赋予行为性质的那个目的。

items.en: French entent brought both the noun and the adjective into English.
items.cn: 法语 entent 把名词与形容词一起带入英语。

items.en: Modern law keeps intent as a technical word; everyday speech uses it for absorbed attention.
items.cn: 现代法律保留 intent 为术语，日常言语则用它表示全神贯注。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the aiming root; the near-meaning group holds other words for purpose.
note.cn: 形近组共享「瞄准」词根；近义组收其他表示目的的词语。

entries.definition: The verb of planning to do something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「打算」。

entries.definition: A plan, often less fixed or formal than intent.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「意图」，比 intent 更常指初步想法。

entries.definition: Satisfied, or what something holds.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「满足的」，名词义为「内容」。

entries.definition: The reason for which something is done.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目的」，做事的理由。

entries.definition: The target one tries to reach.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目标」，想达到的那一点。

entries.definition: Firmness of will, the quality rather than the goal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「决心」，指品质而非目标。

normalIntro.en: The hooks take the taut bow of intendere and the legal phrase with intent.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子取自 intendere 那张绷紧的弓，以及法律短语 with intent。

normal.en: Intent is an aim pulled tight and held.
normal.cn: intent 是一个被拉紧且保持住的目标。

normal.en: The police asked about intent, not about accident.
normal.cn: 警方问的是意图，而不是意外。

normal.en: Be intent on the road, not on the phone.
normal.cn: 要专注于路，而不是手机。

normal.en: For all intents and purposes, the deal is done.
normal.cn: 就各方面而言，这笔交易已成。

normal.en: An intent look is quiet, not busy.
normal.cn: 专注的神情是静的，不是忙的。

abstract.en: Intent is the arrow's straight line before release.
abstract.cn: 意图是离弦前那支箭的直线。

abstract.en: We cannot see intent, only its shadow in behaviour.
abstract.cn: 我们看不见意图，只能看见它在行为里的影子。

abstract.en: A fixed eye makes a still body.
abstract.cn: 目光一固定，身体就静止。

examples.en: His intent was to protect the family business.
examples.cn: 他的意图是保住家族生意。

examples.en: The boy sat intent on his drawing for an hour.
examples.cn: 男孩专心画画，坐了一小时。

examples.en: She was intent on reaching the summit by noon.
examples.cn: 她一心想在中午前登顶。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因贴他」——心里贴着某个目标，就是意图

root: 拉丁语 tendere「伸展」→ intendere「把心瞄向」→ 分词 intensus → 古法语 entent → 英语 intent。同族：intend、intention、intentive。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: a purpose, fixed attention, and firm determination.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：目的、专注，以及坚定的决心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body held still with eyes locked on one point.
core.cn: 核心意象：身体一动不动，双眼锁住一点。

branches.en: THE COURTROOM: the purpose behind an act is examined.
branches.cn: 法庭这条线：审的是行为背后的目的。

branches.en: THE MAGICIAN'S HANDS: attention is all given.
branches.cn: 魔术师的手这条线：注意力全部交出。

branches.en: THE CLIMB: the aim will not let the will relax.
branches.cn: 登山这条线：目标不让意志松手。

branches.en: THE LINK: purpose and will both keep one point fixed.
branches.cn: 连接线：目的与意志都把一点固定住。

branches.en: THE LINK: absorbed attention looks like determination.
branches.cn: 连接线：全神贯注看起来就像决心。

definition_zh: 意图；意向；打算
definition_en: a plan or aim that you have in mind, especially before doing something
core_image: 出门前在便签上写下一行小计划，贴在门边
scene: 桌角压着一张便签，上面写着明早要去的地方，还有要带的东西。He had no intention of selling the boat, whatever the price.
sceneCN: 这里 intention 是「打算、意向」（第 1 个义项：心里的计划），句意无论价钱多少，他都无意卖掉那条船。画面里的物件：便签、压纸的茶杯、笔。

pos.zh: 名词：意图；意向；打算

senses.title: A plan in mind
senses.definition: something you plan or mean to do, often before any action is taken
senses.definitionCN: 你计划或打算要做的事，常在行动之前就在心里
senses.example: Her intention was to study law, not medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 她的打算是学法律，不是学医。
senses.why: Latin intentio names the stretching of the mind towards a target.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intentio 指心灵朝目标伸展的动作。

senses.title: The reason behind an act
senses.definition: the purpose that explains why something was done
senses.definitionCN: 解释某事为何被做的那个目的
senses.example: The letter was written with the best of intentions.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信是怀着一片好意写的。
senses.why: Actions are read through intentions: the same deed can be kind or cruel.
senses.whyCN: 行为要透过用意来读：同一个举动可以是善意，也可以是残忍。

senses.title: Meaning in words
senses.definition: the meaning a speaker or writer wants words to carry
senses.definitionCN: 说话或写作的人希望词语承载的意义
senses.example: The intention of the rule is to keep the path clear.
senses.exampleCN: 这条规则的用意是让小路保持通畅。
senses.why: Law and criticism speak of the intention of a text when they argue about meaning.
senses.whyCN: 法律与批评在争论意义时，会谈文本的「意图」。

intro.en: Intention is the Latin noun intentio, "a stretching towards", from intendere.
intro.cn: intention 是拉丁语名词 intentio「朝……伸展」，来自 intendere。

items.en: In- "towards" with tendere "to stretch" gives intendere.
items.cn: in-「朝向」与 tendere「伸展」构成 intendere。

items.en: Intentio named both the physical tension and the aim of the mind.
items.cn: intentio 兼指物理的张力与心灵的瞄准。

items.en: Scholastic writers used intentio for the direction of the will and of meaning.
items.cn: 经院作家用 intentio 指意志的方向与意义所指。

items.en: French entencion brought the word into English writing in the Middle Ages.
items.cn: 中世纪时法语 entencion 把此词带入英语写作。

items.en: English kept the plain sense of a plan and the legal sense of what a rule is for.
items.cn: 英语保留了「打算」的平实义与「规则为何而立」的法律义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the aiming root; the near-meaning group holds words for plans and purposes.
note.cn: 形近组共享「瞄准」词根；近义组收表示计划与目的的词。

entries.definition: Purpose, often sharper and more legal than intention.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「意图」，常更尖锐、更偏法律。

entries.definition: The verb that carries the plan.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，承载这个计划。

entries.definition: Something newly created, not planned.

entries.definition: A set of steps written out for the future.

entries.definition: The reason a thing exists or is done.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目的」，事物存在的理由。

entries.definition: The single point one hopes to hit.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目标」，希望命中的那一点。

normalIntro.en: The hooks connect the note on the desk with the phrases surrounding intention.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把桌上那张便签与 intention 周边的搭配连起来。

normal.en: An intention is a promise made to yourself first.
normal.cn: 意图是先对自己许下的诺言。

normal.en: I have no intention of arguing about the price.
normal.cn: 我无意在价格上争论。

normal.en: With the intention of helping, he said too much.
normal.cn: 他本意是帮忙，却说多了。

normal.en: Good intentions cannot replace good results.
normal.cn: 好意图代替不了好结果。

normal.en: The intention of the law matters as much as its words.
normal.cn: 法律的用意与它的字句同样重要。

abstract.en: Intention is a seed that may never see daylight.
abstract.cn: 意图是一颗也许见不到光的种子。

abstract.en: Between intention and deed lies the whole person.
abstract.cn: 意图与行为之间，横着整个人。

abstract.en: We judge our own intentions and others' actions.
abstract.cn: 我们看自己的用心，看别人的行为。

examples.en: She had every intention of calling you back.
examples.cn: 她本来很打算给你回电话。

examples.en: The bridge was built with the intention of cutting travel time.
examples.cn: 修这座桥的用意是缩短通行时间。

examples.en: His good intentions did not save the meeting.
examples.cn: 他的好心并没有挽救那次会议。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small note pinned by the door before leaving.
core.cn: 核心意象：出门前贴在门边的一张小便签。

branches.en: THE NOTE: the plan exists before any action.
branches.cn: 便签这条线：计划先于行动而存在。

branches.en: THE LETTER: a kind act or a cruel one depends on the reason.
branches.cn: 那封信这条线：善举或恶行取决于用意。

branches.en: THE RULE: words carry a purpose beyond their letters.
branches.cn: 规则这条线：字句之外还带着用意。

branches.en: THE LINK: plan and reason are the same aim seen before and after.
branches.cn: 连接线：打算与用意是同一目标的前后两面。

branches.cn: 连接线：行为与文本都要被读出意图。
