definition_zh: 相互作用；互相影响；互动
definition_en: to act on each other, or to talk and do things together with other people
core_image: 两个人对着同一个屏幕，你按一下，他回应一句
scene: 小区广场上几个孩子轮流推着同一个球，谁推出去谁就笑着跑开。Some medicines interact badly with coffee.
sceneCN: 这里 interact 是「相互作用、互相配合」（第 1 个义项：彼此产生影响），句意有些药与咖啡同用会产生不良反应。画面里的物件：传着的球、笑声、药盒与咖啡杯。

pos.zh: 动词：相互作用；互相影响；互动

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「相互作用；互动」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「互动的」
由 interactive 加 -ly 构成，义为「互动地」
由本词去前缀构成，义为「反应」

senses.title: Things acting on each other
senses.definition: to have an effect on each other, as substances, forces, or systems do
senses.definitionCN: 像物质、力或系统那样彼此产生影响
senses.example: The two chemicals interact only when heated.
senses.exampleCN: 这两种化学品只在加热时才相互作用。
senses.why: Inter- means between, agere means to do; together they describe mutual action.
senses.whyCN: inter- 意为「在之间」，agere 意为「做」，合起来即相互的动作。

senses.title: People dealing with people
senses.definition: to talk, work, or play with other people
senses.definitionCN: 与他人交谈、共事或一起玩
senses.example: The children learn to interact before they learn to read.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们先学会相处，再学会阅读。
senses.why: Social life is modelled as actions exchanged between persons.
senses.whyCN: 社交生活被看作人与人之间交换的动作。

senses.title: Users and machines
senses.definition: to use a device or program, giving it instructions and receiving responses
senses.definitionCN: 使用装置或程序，给出指令并收到回应
senses.example: Visitors can interact with the map by touching any district.
senses.exampleCN: 访客可以触碰任一区域来与地图互动。
senses.why: Computing borrowed the word for the back-and-forth between people and machines.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域借这个词形容人与机器之间的往来。

intro.en: Interact joins Latin inter- "between" to agere "to do", a verb English borrowed from react.
intro.cn: interact 把拉丁语 inter-「在……之间」接到 agere「做」上，而英语是借 react 而造出它的。

items.en: Agere means to drive, do, or act, and yields actus and actio.
items.cn: agere 意为驱动、做、行动，生出 actus 与 actio。

items.en: Inter as a preposition meant between, among, or mutually.
items.cn: inter 作介词意为「在……之间、互相」。

items.en: React appeared first; interact was coined in the early nineteenth century on its pattern.
items.cn: 先有 react，interact 在十九世纪初按它的样子造出。

items.en: Scientists used it for forces and substances acting mutually.
items.cn: 科学家用它指力与物质的相互作用。

items.en: Social science and computing made it the ordinary word for people and screens.
items.cn: 社会科学与计算机让它成为形容人与屏幕的日常词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the agere root of doing; the near-meaning group holds other words for mutual contact.
note.cn: 形近组共享「做」这一词根 agere；近义组收表示相互接触的词。

entries.definition: To act back when something happens to you.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「反应」，对发生的事情作出回应。

entries.definition: A business deal, an acting across between two parties.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交易」，双方之间完成的一次业务。

entries.definition: To do something, or a deed.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「行动」，名词义为「行为」。

entries.definition: To pass information or feeling to another.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「沟通」，传递信息或感受。

entries.definition: To work with others towards one aim.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「合作」，为同一目标共同努力。

entries.definition: To mix freely in a crowd.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「交际」，在人群中自由往来。

normalIntro.en: The hooks split the word into inter- and act and follow where it is actually used.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把词拆成 inter- 与 act，并沿着它实际使用的场合走。

normal.en: Inter plus act: doing between, back and forth.
normal.cn: inter 加 act：在双方之间来回地做。

normal.en: Two medicines may interact; two friends certainly will.
normal.cn: 两种药会相互作用；两个朋友更是一定会。

normal.en: Children interact with toys before they speak perfectly.
normal.cn: 孩子说话还不流利时就会与玩具互动。

normal.en: Users interact with the map by tapping.
normal.cn: 用户靠轻触与地图互动。

normal.en: React is to act back; interact is to act together.
normal.cn: react 是回身反应，interact 是彼此一起动。

abstract.en: Nothing stands alone: everything interacts.
abstract.cn: 没有东西独自立着，万物都在相互作用。

abstract.en: Characters in a story are known by how they interact.
abstract.cn: 故事里的人物靠彼此往来而被认出来。

abstract.en: The word marks the space between two doings.
abstract.cn: 这个词标出两件事之间的那段空间。

examples.en: These drugs interact with each other and must not be mixed.
examples.cn: 这些药会相互作用，不能混用。

examples.en: Pupils interact with visiting speakers in small groups.
examples.cn: 学生们以小组形式与来访的讲者互动。

examples.en: The child had hardly interacted with anyone all term.
examples.cn: 这孩子整个学期几乎没和任何人来往。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特爱克」——网络特长爱互相切磋，就是互动

root: 拉丁语 inter-「在……之间」+ agere「做、驱动」→ 英语先有 react，再按此模式造出 interact。同族：interaction、react、act。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: mutual action of things, social dealings, and using a device.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：事物的相互作用、人际往来，以及使用装置。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people pushing one ball back and forth.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人来回推同一个球。

branches.en: THE TWO CHEMICALS: heat makes them act on each other.
branches.cn: 两种化学品这条线：加热使它们相互起作用。

branches.en: THE PLAYGROUND: play is an exchange of actions.
branches.cn: 操场这条线：游戏就是动作的交换。

branches.en: THE TOUCH SCREEN: a tap brings a reply.
branches.cn: 触屏这条线：一触得到回应。

branches.en: THE LINK: mutual action applies to bodies and to people.
branches.cn: 连接线：相互动作既用于物体也用于人。

branches.en: THE LINK: machines are treated as social partners.
branches.cn: 连接线：机器被当作社交对象。

intro.en: Interact = inter- "between" + act, from Latin agere "to do".
intro.cn: interact = inter-「在……之间」+ act（来自拉丁语 agere「做」）。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter and agere are both recorded; the English compound is modern.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 与 agere 均有记载，英语的合成词则是近代产物。

items.example: From agere, the root of many words.
items.exampleCN: 来自 agere，许多词共同的根。

items.example: The -ent of agere is visible here.
items.exampleCN: agere 的 -ent 在这里可见。

items.example: A plural of the same Latin stem.
items.exampleCN: 同一拉丁词干的复数形式。

definition_zh: 相互作用；交互作用；互动
definition_en: the activity of two or more things or people acting on each other
core_image: 两端各有一只手来回拉同一根绳子，绳子中间打了几个结
scene: 课堂上老师抛出问题，学生接一句，老师再回一句，话在两边来回飞。Daily interaction with neighbours keeps a street safe.
sceneCN: 这里 interaction 是「互动、相互作用」（第 1 个义项：彼此往来的过程），句意与邻居的日常往来让街道更安全。画面里的物件：课桌、举起的手、街角的门阶。

pos.zh: 名词：相互作用；交互作用；互动

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉 -ion 构成，义为「互动；互相作用」
由本词换后缀构成，义为「互动的」
由 interactive 加 -ly 构成，义为「互动地」
由本词加 -al 构成，义为「与互动有关的」

senses.title: People acting on people
senses.definition: the way people behave towards and respond to one another
senses.definitionCN: 人们彼此相处并相互回应的方式
senses.example: Short interactions at the shop door can make a lonely day lighter.
senses.exampleCN: 店门口几句短短的往来，能让孤单的一天变轻松。
senses.why: It is the noun of action of interact, from Latin inter plus agere.
senses.whyCN: 它是 interact 的行为名词，来自拉丁语 inter 加 agere。

senses.title: Things affecting each other
senses.definition: the combined effect of two or more forces, substances, or systems on each other
senses.definitionCN: 两种或多种力、物质或系统彼此的合成影响
senses.example: The interaction between wind and current shaped the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 风与海流的相互作用塑造了海岸。
senses.why: Science speaks of interactions where a single cause will not explain a result.
senses.whyCN: 在单一原因解释不了结果时，科学就谈相互作用。

senses.title: In scientific research
senses.definition: a measurable effect in which one factor changes how another factor works
senses.definitionCN: 一种可测量的效应：一个因素改变了另一个因素的作用方式
senses.example: The study found an interaction between diet and sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 研究发现饮食与睡眠之间存在交互效应。
senses.why: Statistics needed a word for two things acting together rather than separately.
senses.whyCN: 统计学需要一个词指两个因素一起起作用而不是各自起作用。

senses.title: With machines
senses.definition: the exchange between a user and a device or program
senses.definitionCN: 使用者与装置或程序之间的交换
senses.example: Good design makes interaction with the machine feel natural.
senses.exampleCN: 好的设计让与机器的往来显得自然。
senses.why: Software designers borrowed the social word to describe tapping and typing.
senses.whyCN: 软件设计者借用了这个社交词来描述点按与打字。

intro.en: Interaction combines inter- "between", agere "to do", and the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: interaction 由 inter-「之间」、agere「做」与名词词尾 -ion 组成。

items.en: Agere "to do, drive" supplied actus and actio.
items.cn: agere「做、驱动」提供了 actus 与 actio。

items.en: Inter as a prefix marked what happens between two parties.
items.cn: inter 作前缀标出发生在两方之间的事。

items.en: Interaction was formed in the eighteenth century for mutual influence.
items.cn: interaction 在十八世纪成形，指相互影响。

items.en: Social science adopted it for the study of persons and groups.
items.cn: 社会科学采用它来研究个人与群体。

items.en: Computing added human-computer interaction, now a field of its own.
items.cn: 计算机领域添上了「人机交互」，如今已是独立学科。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the agere root; the near-meaning group holds other words for exchanges.
note.cn: 形近组共享 agere 词根；近义组收其他表示交流的词。

entries.definition: The verb of acting mutually.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「互动」。

entries.definition: A response to something that happened.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「反应」，对已发生之事的回应。

entries.definition: Doing something, without the mutual element.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动」，不含相互之意。

entries.definition: The passing of information or feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交流」，传达信息或感受。

entries.definition: The mere fact of touching or meeting.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「接触」，只指碰上或会面。

entries.definition: A giving and taking in return.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交换」，给出去并收回。

normalIntro.en: The hooks hold on to the image of words flying back and forth across a room.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子抓住「话在房间里来回飞」这一画面。

normal.en: Inter- between, act do, -ion the process: doing between.
normal.cn: inter- 在之间，act 做，-ion 过程：在双方之间来回做。

normal.en: Social interaction at the door can save a whole day.
normal.cn: 门口几句交往能救回一整天的心情。

normal.en: Wind and water interaction built the harbour.
normal.cn: 风与水的相互作用造出了这个港口。

normal.en: Human-computer interaction is now taught as its own subject.
normal.cn: 人机交互如今已作为独立学科讲授。

normal.en: Fewer screens means more face-to-face interaction.
normal.cn: 少盯屏幕就多一些面对面往来。

abstract.en: Everything interesting happens between things.
abstract.cn: 一切有趣的事都发生在事物之间。

abstract.en: A conversation is a rope pulled from both ends.
abstract.cn: 一段对话是一根两端都在拉的绳。

abstract.en: Isolation is the absence of a single interaction.
abstract.cn: 孤立就是连一次往来都没有。

examples.en: Regular interaction with teachers helps shy children speak up.
examples.cn: 常与老师往来能让害羞的孩子开口。

examples.en: The interaction of light and shadow gives the painting its depth.
examples.cn: 光与影的相互作用赋予这幅画深度。

examples.en: The app was praised for smooth interaction between pages.
examples.cn: 这款应用因页面之间流畅的交互而受到称赞。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特爱克神」——网上互相支持得很神，就是互动

root: 拉丁语 inter-「在……之间」+ agere「做、驱动」+ -ion → 英语 interaction。同族：interact、interactive、react、action。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: people with people, things with things, statistical effects, and users with machines.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：人与人的往来、物与物的影响、统计上的交互效应，以及人与机器的往来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rope pulled from both ends, knotted in the middle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根两端都在拉的绳，中间打了结。

branches.en: THE SHOP DOOR: small exchanges between neighbours.
branches.cn: 店门这条线：邻里之间的小小往来。

branches.en: THE COAST: wind and water make one shape together.
branches.cn: 海岸这条线：风与水共同造出一个形状。

branches.en: THE STUDY: one factor changes another's effect.
branches.cn: 研究这条线：一个因素改变另一因素的作用。

branches.en: THE SCREEN: a tap and a reply count as a social act.
branches.cn: 屏幕这条线：一点一回应被当作社交动作。

branches.en: THE LINK: machines join human social habits.
branches.cn: 连接线：机器进入了人的社交习惯。

intro.en: Interaction = inter- "between" + act- "do" + -ion.
intro.cn: interaction = inter-「在……之间」+ act-「做」+ -ion。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter and agere are attested; the modern noun is English-built.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 与 agere 有记载，这个近代名词是英语自行构成。

items.example: It forms reaction, the one-way cousin.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 reaction，只回不互的表亲。

items.example: It allows multi-interaction in new writing.
items.exampleCN: 它使新写作里能说多方互动。

definition_zh: 兴趣；利益；利息；v. 使感兴趣
definition_en: the feeling of wanting to know more about something, an advantage you gain, or money paid for the use of money
core_image: 一个人把头探过桌边，眼睛跟着别人手里的书页一起移动
scene: 少年挤在人群外圈，踮着脚看摊主手上的老式钟表，舍不得走。The bank pays a little interest on that account each month.
sceneCN: 这里 interest 是「兴趣」（第 1 个义项：想知道更多的心情），句意银行每月给那个账户付一点利息，用的是第 2 个义项。画面里的物件：老式钟表、踮起的脚、存折。

pos.zh: 名词：兴趣；利益；利息；股份
动词：使感兴趣；引起（某人）注意

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「有趣的」
由过去分词转作形容词，义为「感兴趣的」
由 interesting 加 -ly 构成，义为「有趣的是」
由否定前缀 dis- 加过去分词构成，义为「不带私利的」

senses.title: Wanting to know more
senses.definition: a feeling of curiosity or attention that makes you want to know more about something
senses.definitionCN: 一种好奇或注意的心情，使你想对某事了解更多
senses.example: His interest in old watches began at a street market.
senses.exampleCN: 他对旧钟表的兴趣始于一个街头小市集。
senses.why: Latin interest means "it is between", that is, it makes a difference to someone.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interest 意为「它在其间」，即与人有关、对人有差别。

senses.title: Money paid for money
senses.definition: the money that a borrower pays to a lender for the use of the money over time
senses.definitionCN: 借用人因使用这笔钱而按时间付给放款人的钱
senses.example: A small loan at seven per cent interest adds up quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 百分之七利率的小额贷款很快就滚出不少钱。
senses.why: Roman law made it profitable to have a stake in a loan, and interest came to mean that stake.
senses.whyCN: 罗马法使在借贷中占一份成为有利可图之事，interest 遂指这「一份」。

senses.title: What is good for you
senses.definition: the advantage or benefit of a person or group
senses.definitionCN: 个人或团体的好处与得益
senses.example: The road was closed in the interest of safety.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路为了安全而被封闭。
senses.why: What makes a difference to you is also what serves your advantage.
senses.whyCN: 对你有差别的事，也就是对你有利的事。

senses.title: A share in a business
senses.definition: a legal share or stake in a company or property
senses.definitionCN: 在公司或财产中的合法份额
senses.example: She sold her interest in the shop to her partner.
senses.exampleCN: 她把店里的股份卖给了合伙人。
senses.why: From a stake in a loan the word widened to any ownership share.
senses.whyCN: 从借贷中的一份，此词扩展到任何所有权份额。

senses.title: To draw attention
senses.definition: to make someone want to know or take part
senses.definitionCN: 使某人想了解或参与
senses.example: The teacher interested the class in the old maps on the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 老师让全班对墙上的旧地图产生了兴趣。
senses.why: The verb reverses the noun: it plants the curiosity instead of feeling it.
senses.whyCN: 动词把名词反过来用：不是产生好奇，而是种下好奇。

intro.en: Interest began as the Latin verb phrase interest "it makes a difference", from inter and esse "to be".
intro.cn: interest 起初是拉丁语动词短语 interest「与之有关」，由 inter 与 esse「存在」构成。

items.en: Interest is literally "it is between", used in phrases like interest reipublicae, it matters to the state.
items.cn: interest 字面是「它在中间」，见于 interest reipublicae 等短语，意谓对国家有干系。

items.en: Roman law compensated a lender for the delay in repayment, weighing what it mattered to him.
items.cn: 罗马法就延迟还款补偿放款人，衡量的正是此事对他有多大干系。

items.en: French interest narrowed to mean money paid for the use of money.
items.cn: 法语 interest 窄化为为使用金钱而付的钱。

items.en: English took interest in the sixteenth century for both money and advantage.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 interest，兼指利息与好处。

items.en: The sense of curiosity appeared later and became the commonest use of all.
items.cn: 「好奇」这一义项较晚出现，却成了最常见用法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin verb esse "to be"; the near-meaning group holds other words for attention and money.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语动词 esse「存在」；近义组收表示注意与钱财的词。

entries.definition: The adjective for things that hold attention.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容能吸引注意的事物。

entries.definition: The adjective for the person who feels interest.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容感到兴趣的人。

entries.definition: Free from personal gain, not merely bored.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「无利害关系的」，并非「不感兴趣」。

entries.definition: The wish to know, without any stake.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「好奇心」，不带利益。

entries.definition: An advantage, especially as a right.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「益处」，尤指应得的权利。

entries.definition: Money made from a business after costs.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「利润」，扣除成本后的所赚。

normalIntro.en: The hooks run from the phrase "it matters to me" to the exact phrases interest lives in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从「这事与我有关」一路走到 interest 的真实搭配。

normal.en: Interest first meant "it is between": it stands between a person and a thing.
normal.cn: interest 最早意为「在其中间」：站在人与事物之间。

normal.en: Be interested in a topic, take an interest in a hobby.
normal.cn: 对话题用 be interested in，对爱好用 take an interest in。

normal.en: Interest on a loan is your stake in the lender's delay.
normal.cn: 贷款的利息就是你对放款人拖延所占的那一份。

normal.en: In the interest of safety, the road was closed.
normal.cn: 为了安全，这条路被封闭。

normal.en: A conflict of interest means two gains pull against each other.
normal.cn: 利益冲突指的是两份好处互相拉扯。

abstract.en: Interest is the thread that ties attention to advantage.
abstract.cn: 兴趣是把注意力与好处系在一起的那根线。

abstract.en: Money grows by interest; the mind grows by interest too.
abstract.cn: 钱靠利息增长，心也靠兴趣增长。

abstract.en: What matters to you will always hold your eyes.
abstract.cn: 与你有关的事总会牵住你的眼睛。

examples.en: Her interest in birds began with a single nest outside the window.
examples.cn: 她对鸟的兴趣始于窗外的一个鸟巢。

examples.en: The loan is repaid with interest over five years.
examples.cn: 这笔贷款在五年内连本带息还清。

examples.en: He acted in the interest of the whole village, not himself.
examples.cn: 他是为整个村子而非自己行事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因戳瑞斯特」——因被戳到痒处，立刻来了兴趣

root: 拉丁语 inter「在……之间」+ esse「存在」→ 动词短语 interest「与之有关」→ 古法语 interest → 英语 interest。同族：interesting、interested。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: curiosity, money for money, advantage, a share in a business, and the verb of arousing curiosity.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：好奇、钱生钱的利息、好处、生意里的份额，以及使人上心的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person leaning forward, eyes following someone else's book.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人探身向前，眼睛跟着别人手里的书走。

branches.en: THE MARKET STALL: curiosity makes the boy stop walking.
branches.cn: 小摊这条线：好奇心让少年停住脚。

branches.en: THE SAVINGS BOOK: money earns money over time.
branches.cn: 存折这条线：钱随时间再生钱。

branches.en: THE CLOSED ROAD: a benefit is weighed against a cost.
branches.cn: 封闭的路这条线：好处要与代价权衡。

branches.en: THE SOLD SHARE: ownership is the same stake in property.
branches.cn: 卖出的股份这条线：所有权即财产中的一份。

branches.en: THE OLD MAPS: a teacher plants the curiosity.
branches.cn: 旧地图这条线：老师把好奇种下去。

intro.en: Interest has no living prefix-and-suffix split in English: it is frozen Latin, inter "between" plus the verb "to be".
intro.cn: interest 在英语里已无活的词缀可分，是一块冻结的拉丁语：inter「在……之间」加「存在」动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin interest and the phrase interest reipublicae are recorded; only the deepest IE layer is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interest 与短语 interest reipublicae 均有记载，只有最深的印欧层是重构。

items.example: It places the matter among people.
items.exampleCN: 它把这件事安放在人与人之间。

items.example: The verb behind est and interest.
items.exampleCN: est 与 interest 背后的动词。

items.example: The frozen source of the English word.
It forms disinterested, free of gain.

definition_zh: 干涉；妨碍；干扰
definition_en: to become involved in something in a way that is not wanted, or to disturb what is happening
core_image: 一只手伸进两台正在咬合的齿轮之间，把事情搅乱
scene: 两个人在谈事情，第三个人忽然插进来替其中一人作答。Please do not interfere while the machine is being repaired.
sceneCN: 这里 interfere 是「干涉、妨碍」（第 1 个义项：以不受欢迎的方式介入），句意机器正在修理，请勿干扰。画面里的物件：齿轮、插话的第三人、修理工具。

pos.zh: 动词：干涉；妨碍；干扰

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ence 构成，义为「干涉；干扰」
由现在分词转作形容词，义为「爱管闲事的」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「干涉者」
由否定前缀 non- 加本词构成，义为「不干涉」

senses.title: Meddle in others' affairs
senses.definition: to take part in something that is not your business, often with unwelcome results
senses.definitionCN: 参与本不归你管的事，常常带来不受欢迎的后果
senses.example: The neighbours interfered in the argument and made it worse.
senses.exampleCN: 邻居们插手这场争吵，反而让它更糟。
senses.why: Latin ferire means to strike; interferire is to strike in between two things.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ferire 意为「击打」，interferire 即「在两者之间打进去」。

senses.title: Disturb or hinder
senses.definition: to hinder or disturb a process, signal, or activity that was working well
senses.definitionCN: 妨碍或扰乱原本进行良好的过程、信号或活动
senses.example: Bright lights interfere with the sensor.
senses.exampleCN: 强光会干扰传感器。
senses.why: Radio engineers took the verb up because one wave can strike across another.
senses.whyCN: 无线电工程师采用了这个动词，因为一束波会横穿过另一束。

senses.title: Touch what is not yours
senses.definition: to touch or handle something that you should leave alone, especially in a harmful way
senses.definitionCN: 触碰或摆弄本该不动的某物，尤指造成损害
senses.example: Do not let anyone interfere with the wiring.
senses.exampleCN: 别让任何人动那套线路。
senses.why: The original physical sense survives where hands actually meddle with objects.
senses.whyCN: 在最原始的身体意义上，这个词指手真的去碰东西。

intro.en: Interfere combines inter- "between" with the Latin verb ferire "to strike".
intro.cn: interfere 把 inter-「在……之间」与拉丁语动词 ferire「击打」结合在一起。

items.en: Ferire "to strike" was common in Latin for blows and struck deals.
items.cn: ferire「击打」在拉丁语中常见于「打」与「成交」的说法。

items.en: Interferire was rare and meant to come between with a blow.
items.cn: interferire 很少见，意为「用一击插到中间」。

items.en: French s'entreférir carried the idea of clashing or hitting against.
items.cn: 法语 s'entreférir 带有相撞、对冲的意思。

items.en: English first used interfere of horses striking their hooves together.
items.cn: 英语早期用 interfere 形容马匹的蹄子相撞。

items.en: The sense shifted to getting in the way, then to meddling in other's affairs.
items.cn: 意义转向「挡路」，再转向「插手别人的事」。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the striking root; the near-meaning group holds other words for getting in the way.

abstract.en: Every blow struck between two things leaves a mark.

abstract.en: Some things grow best when nobody interferes.

senses.title: Meddling

intro.en: Interference is the English noun formed on interfere, from Latin ferire "to strike".

items.en: Radio and sport each gave it a fixed technical sense.

senses.title: The inside space
senses.definition: the inside part of a building, room, or vehicle
senses.definitionCN: 建筑、房间或车辆内部的那部分
senses.example: The interior of the van smelled of new paint.
senses.exampleCN: 货车内部有一股新油漆味。
senses.why: Latin interior is the comparative of the adjective meaning "inner".
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interior 是意为「内部的」形容词的比较级。

senses.title: The land far from the coast
senses.definition: the central part of a country, away from the sea and borders
senses.definitionCN: 一国的中心部分，远离海岸与边境
senses.example: Traders carried salt far into the interior.
senses.exampleCN: 商人们运盐深入内陆。
senses.why: Explorers spoke of the interior because maps stopped at the coast.
senses.whyCN: 航海者谈「内陆」，因为地图止于海岸线。

senses.title: The inside story
senses.definition: the part of a person or a thing that is not shown outwardly
senses.definitionCN: 人或事物不外露的那部分
senses.example: Her calm voice hid a troubled interior.
senses.exampleCN: 她平静的声音下藏着不安的内心。
senses.why: The spatial word moves inward to name hidden feeling.
senses.whyCN: 这个空间词向内延伸，用来指隐藏的感受。

senses.title: Home affairs
senses.definition: the domestic affairs of a country as opposed to its foreign policy
senses.definitionCN: 一国的国内事务，与外交政策相对
senses.example: The interior minister promised tighter border checks.
senses.exampleCN: 内政部长承诺加强边境检查。
senses.why: Governments name domestic affairs by the word for inside space.
senses.whyCN: 政府用表示内部空间的词来命名国内事务。

intro.en: Interior is the Latin comparative of an inner adjective; it came to English as both noun and adjective.

items.exampleCN: 它把「在里面」变成「更在里面」。

items.example: A near twin with a different ending.
items.exampleCN: 另一个同源近亲，词尾不同。

definition_zh: 中间的；中级的；n. 中间物；中级学习者
definition_en: coming between two things in level or position, or a person at a middle stage of learning
core_image: 三段楼梯中间的第三级台阶上放着一盏灯，上下各有台阶
scene: 语言班门口挂着一块牌子，把班级分成初级、中级、高级三栏。She moved from the beginner class to an intermediate one in a term.
sceneCN: 这里 intermediate 是「中级的」（第 1 个义项：处于两端之间），句意她一个学期就从初级班升到了中级班。画面里的物件：班级分栏牌、台阶、课本。

pos.zh: 形容词：中间的；中级的；中等的
名词：中间物；中级学习者

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「居间调解；中介」
由同一词干构成，义为「中间人」
去掉前缀 inter- 的直接对照词，义为「立即的；直接的」
由同一拉丁词干构成，义为「调解者」

senses.title: In the middle of a scale
senses.definition: at a level between the basic and the advanced
senses.definitionCN: 处于基础与高级之间的水平
senses.example: The book is written for intermediate learners of English.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书是为中级英语学习者写的。
senses.why: The Latin stem medius "middle" with inter- marks a point between two ends.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语词干 medius「中间」与 inter- 相合，标出介于两端之间的点。

senses.title: Between two stages or places
senses.definition: happening or lying between two other things in time or space
senses.definitionCN: 在时间或位置上位于另外两事之间
senses.example: The larva spends several weeks in an intermediate stage.
senses.exampleCN: 幼虫在中间阶段要经过好几周。
senses.why: Latin medius "middle" with inter- marks a point that is in between.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 medius「中间」与 inter- 相合，标出介于两者之间的点。

senses.title: Not directly connected
senses.definition: happening through an extra step rather than directly
senses.definitionCN: 经由额外一步而非直接地发生
senses.example: The sugar is broken down into intermediate products first.
senses.exampleCN: 糖先被分解成中间产物。
senses.why: Chemistry and economics both need names for halfway results.
senses.whyCN: 化学与经济学都需要为半途的产物命名。

senses.title: A person at that level
senses.definition: a learner or athlete who is no longer a beginner but not yet advanced
senses.definitionCN: 已不是新手但尚未达到高水平的学练者
senses.example: The class mixes intermediates with a few beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 这个班以中级学员为主，也混着几个新手。
senses.why: The adjective turned into a noun for people in the middle band.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词活用作名词，指处在中间一档的人。

intro.en: Intermediate joins Latin inter- "between" to medius "middle", with the adjective ending -ate.
intro.cn: intermediate 把拉丁语 inter-「在……之间」接到 medius「中间」上，再加形容词词尾 -ate。

items.en: Medius means middle, and gives English medium and mediate.
items.cn: medius 意为「中间的」，给出英语 medium 与 mediate。

items.en: Mediatus, the participle of mediare "to be in the middle", supplied the ending.
items.cn: mediare「居于中间」的分词 mediatus 提供了词尾。

items.en: Intermediatus named what lies between two stages.
items.cn: intermediatus 指位于两个阶段之间之物。

items.en: English adopted intermediate for space, then for levels of skill.
items.cn: 英语先用 intermediate 指空间，再指技能等级。

items.en: Schools and exams fixed it as the band between beginner and advanced.
items.cn: 学校与考试把它固定为初级与高级之间的那一档。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the middle root medius; the near-meaning group holds other words for middleness.
note.cn: 形近组共享「中间」词根 medius；近义组收其他表示居中的词。

entries.definition: With nothing in between, hence instant.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「立即的、直接的」。

entries.definition: A person or body that goes between others.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「中间人」。

entries.definition: A middle size, or a means of communication.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「中号」或「媒介」。

entries.definition: The everyday word for the central part.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或形容词，最日常的「中间」。

entries.definition: Neither great nor small; not extreme.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「适中的」，不极端。

entries.definition: Belonging to a period of change between two states.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「过渡的」，处于变化之中。

normalIntro.en: The hooks split the word into inter- and media, the Latin middle.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把词分成 inter- 与拉丁语表示「中间」的 media。

normal.en: Inter plus media: between the middles, that is, in the middle.
normal.cn: inter 加 media：在中间之中，也就是居中。

normal.en: Beginner, intermediate, advanced: three steps on one stair.
normal.cn: 初级、中级、高级：一道楼梯上的三级。

normal.en: An intermediate stage stands between egg and adult.
normal.cn: 中间阶段站在卵与成虫之间。

normal.en: Immediate has no middle; intermediate is all middle.
normal.cn: immediate 没有中间，intermediate 全是中间。

normal.en: Upper intermediate is still not advanced.
normal.cn: 中高级仍不算高级。

abstract.en: The middle step carries the weight of both directions.
abstract.cn: 中间那级台阶承担着两个方向的重量。

abstract.en: Some things are only ever intermediate, never final.
abstract.cn: 有些东西永远是中途，从不到终点。

abstract.en: Being intermediate is a place to stand, not a verdict.
abstract.cn: 处在中游是一个立足处，不是判决。

examples.en: She joined an intermediate swimming class at fourteen.
examples.cn: 她十四岁时参加了中级游泳班。

examples.en: The two towns are linked by an intermediate station.
examples.cn: 两镇之间靠一个中间站相连。

examples.en: In this reaction an intermediate compound forms and quickly breaks up.
examples.cn: 在这个反应中会先生成一种中间化合物，随后很快分解。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特米迪特」——网上找米迪特的秘诀，先从中级练起

root: 拉丁语 medius「中间的」→ inter-「在……之间」+ mediare「居于中间」→ intermediatus → 英语 intermediate。同族：medium、mediate、immediate、intermediary。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: a middle level, a stage between two, products formed midway, and the people at that level.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：中间水平、介于两阶段之间、中途产物，以及处在该档的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp on the middle step between top and bottom.
core.cn: 核心意象：上下台阶之间的那级台阶上放着灯。

branches.en: THE CLASS LIST: three columns with the middle filled first.
branches.cn: 班级分栏这条线：三栏中最先填满中间一栏。

branches.en: THE LARVA: a body holds a place between two forms.
branches.cn: 幼虫这条线：身体占据两种形态之间的位置。

branches.en: THE REACTION: halfway products appear and vanish.
branches.cn: 反应这条线：中途产物出现又消失。

branches.en: THE SWIMMER: a person occupies the middle band.
branches.cn: 游泳者这条线：人占据中档。

branches.en: THE LINK: bands of skill are stages on a path.
branches.cn: 连接线：技能档次就是路上的阶段。

intro.en: Intermediate = inter- "between" + medi- "middle" + -ate, an adjective ending.
intro.cn: intermediate = inter-「在……之间」+ medi-「中间」+ -ate（形容词词尾）。

latinIntro.en: Latin medius and mediare are recorded; intermediatus is medieval Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 medius 与 mediare 有记载，intermediatus 是中世纪拉丁语。

items.example: It places the middle between two ends.
items.exampleCN: 它把「中」安放在两端之间。
也见于 medium 与 median。

items.example: It makes the word an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它使这个词成为形容词。

items.example: It denies the middle in immediate.
items.exampleCN: 它在 immediate 中否定「中间」。

latinEntries.meaning: to be in the middle, to mediate
